column12: Ultral-low loading of Pt-decorated Ni electrocatalyst, manufacturing method of the same and anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer using the same
column13: Provided is an electrocatalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, including a carbonaceous material, and nickel electrodeposited on the carbonaceous material, wherein nickel is partially substituted with platinum and the substitution with platinum provides increased hydrogen evolution activity as compared to the same electrocatalyst before substitution with platinum. Also provided are a method for preparing the electrocatalyst and an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer using the same. The nickel electrocatalyst coated with an ultralow loading amount of platinum for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis shows excellent hydrogen evolution activity and has a small thickness of catalyst, thereby providing high mass transfer and high catalyst availability. In addition, the electrocatalyst uses a particle-type electrode to facilitate emission of hydrogen bubbles generated during hydrogen evolution reaction and oxygen bubbles generated during oxygen evolution reaction, and requires low cost for preparation to provide high cost-efficiency.

column12: FABRICATION OF REINFORCED ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANES
column13: Methods of preparing reinforced anion exchange membranes are provided, as well as produced membranes and corresponding devices utilizing the membranes. Methods comprise compounding a halide -functionalized polymer (selected to react with amines to yield anion-conducting quaternary amine groups) with thermoplastic polymer(s) (selected to support and/or reinforce the membrane), and with copolymer(s) (selected to enhance the compounding of the polymers) - by heating, mixing and cooling - to form blend pellets, extruding the blend pellets to form a blend film, cross-linking polymer(s), and functionalizing the blend film to prepare the anion exchange membrane. Functionalization comprises a quaternization step comprising reacting halogen groups of the first polymer with tertiary amines to produce the quaternary amine groups with ion-exchange functionality. Reinforced anion exchange membranes are provided, which are produced by the disclosed methods, functionalized to yield a membrane for fuel cell(s), electrolyzer(s), reversible electrochemical device(s), desalination unit(s), etc.

column12: MULTIPLE DENSITY ANODE FOR ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYZERS AND ASSOCIATED METHODS
column13: An anode for an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer is provided. The anode includes a multiple density porous transport layer (MDPTL), which may be considered a multiple porosity porous transport layer (MPPTL), and a catalyst layer coupled to the MDPTL. The MDPTL has at least a first portion that has a first density and a second portion that has a second density that is less than the first density. The first portion has a membrane facing side, is proximal the membrane, and is distal the bipolar plate. The second portion has a bipolar plate facing side, is distal the membrane, and proximal the bipolar plate. The catalyst layer, which is proximal to the membrane as compared to the MDPTL, is coupled to the membrane facing side of the first portion. In certain aspects, the MDPTL includes three or more portions with three or more densities.

column12: ELECTROLYSIS SYSTEM FOR HYDROGEN PRODUCTION AND CARBON DIOXIDE CAPTURE AND DELIVERY
column13: An electrochemical reactor for capturing carbon dioxide and producing bicarbonate and hydrogen is described herein. The electrochemical reactor is useful for, among other things, converting biogas to a bicarbonate and hydrogen feedstock for biomethanation. The reactor comprises at least one reactor unit comprising an electrolyzer cell and at least one alkaline water electrolysis (AWE) cell adjacent to the electrolyzer cell. The electrolyzer cell comprises an anode spaced from a cathode by an ion exchange membrane between the anode and the cathode; and the electrolyzer cell is adapted and arranged to allow a flow of a neutral liquid electrolyte to contact the anode and the cathode. The ion exchange membrane can be a cation exchange membrane (CEM), or an anion exchange membrane (AEM). The AWE cell comprises a second anode spaced from a second cathode by a porous diaphragm.

column12: POLY(SPIROBISINDANE-ARYL PIPERIDINIUM) COPOLYMER IONOMER, ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE, AND METHOD FOR PREPARING SAME
column13: The present disclosure relates to a technology for synthesizing a poly(spirobisindane-aryl piperidinium) copolymer containing a spirobisindane group in a repeating unit with no aryl ether bond in a polymer backbone, and preparing an anion-exchange membrane therefrom. A novel poly(spirobisindane-aryl piperidinium) copolymer ionomer according to the present disclosure has excellent chemical stability and mechanical properties, high ionic conductivity, improved gas permeability, and reduced material transfer resistance. In addition, an anion-exchange membrane and a composite membrane prepared from the poly(spirobisindane-aryl piperidinium) copolymer ionomer have excellent chemical stability, mechanical properties, durability and water management ability and, thus, can be applied to membranes and binders for alkaline fuel cells, water electrolysis devices, carbon dioxide reduction, metal-air batteries, etc.

column12: METHOD FOR ONE-STEP SYNTHESIS OF SINGLE ATOMS AND NANOPARTICLES CO-DECORATED CARBON NANOTUBE ARRAYS
column13: A liquid-assisted chemical vapor deposition method for preparing hierarchical Ni/NiO@Ru—NC nanotube arrays includes forming Ni/NiO@Ru—NC on surfaces of the NF with single-atom Ru anchored on N-doped carbon (Ru—NC) nanotube and Janus Ni/NiO NPs encapsulated on the tips. The forming Ni/NiO@Ru—NC includes pretreating the NF; creating a CH3CN/RuCl3/Ar atmosphere in the tube furnace to in-situ grow the Ni/NiO@Ru—NC nanotube arrays on the pretreated NF. The bifunctional Ni/NiO@Ru—NC electrocatalyst exhibits overpotentials of 88 m V and 261 m V for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER) at 100 mA cm−2 in alkaline solution, respectively. Meanwhile, the bifunctional Ni/NiO@Ru—NC can stably operate an anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) system for 50 hours under 500 mA cm−2 at a voltage of 1.95±0.05 V in a 1.0 M KOH solution at room temperature. An overall water-splitting electrolyzer can be efficiently driven by a solar cell.

column12: DIRECT COATING OF ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANES WITH CATALYTICALLY ACTIVE MATERIAL
column13: The invention relates to the coating of anion exchange membranes (AEM) with catalytically active substances. The CCM thus obtained are used in electrochemical cells, especially for alkaline water electrolysis. It was an object of the invention to specify a process for producing a CCM by direct coating which maintains the necessary planarity of the AEM and ideally avoids the use of lost films and eschews CMR substances. Swelling shall also be minimized. The process shall also be performable with fluorine-free ionomers. The invention is based on the finding that the addition of certain organic substances has the result that the AEM swells only to a small extent, if at all (antiswelling agent). It has surprisingly been found that substances suitable as antiswelling agents are identifiable by their solubility behaviour, more particularly by their Hansen parameters.

This invention encompasses a process for producing and using the membrane in water electrolysis and fuel cell.

column12: MEMBRANE ELECTRODE FOR ALKALINE WATER ELECTROLYSIS FOR HYDROGEN PRODUCTION AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND ELECTROLYTIC CELL
column13: The present disclosure provides a membrane electrode for hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis, a preparation method therefor, and an electrolytic cell. According to the method provided by the present disclosure, a membrane electrode with catalyst layers uniformly and firmly adhered to the surfaces of a membrane can be obtained via a direct coating and hot pressing. The membrane electrode is endowed with good stability, and the obtained membrane electrode exhibits a significantly reduced overpotential for water electrolysis. The method comprises the following steps: directly applying a catalyst slurry (catalyst slurries) onto both sides of a membrane, followed by drying and hot pressing the catalyst slurry (catalyst slurries) to form catalyst layers on each surface of the membrane to obtain the membrane electrode. The membrane is selected from a porous membrane or an alkaline anion exchange membrane; the catalyst slurry comprises a binder solution and a catalyst, wherein the binder solution is one or more selected from a perfluorosulfonic acid resin solution and a perfluorosulfonic acid ionomer dispersion, and the mass concentration of the binder solution is 5% to 30%; and the mass ratio of the binder solution to the catalyst is 1:1 to 4:1.

column12: Electrolytic cell, anion exchange membrane electrode and activation method thereof
column13: The invention provides an electrolytic bath, an anion-exchange membrane electrode and an activation method thereof. The activation method of the anion-exchange membrane electrode comprises the following steps: introducing alkali liquor into the electrolytic bath, and introducing direct current into a to-be-activated anion-exchange membrane. In the embodiment of the invention, the anion-exchange membrane electrode to be activated is electrified in the alkali liquor environment, and the anion-exchange membrane electrode participates in the electrolysis of the solution in the electrolytic bath in the electrifying process, so that the conductivity of the anion-exchange membrane electrode is quickly improved, and the activation process of the anion-exchange membrane electrode is obviously accelerated. Moreover, the activation process can be determined by detecting the conductivity of the anion exchange membrane electrode in the activation process, so that the activation endpoint can be detected by improving the activation process, and the subsequent test is facilitated. Therefore, the technical problems that the activation process of the current anion exchange membrane electrode is slow and the activation endpoint is difficult to judge are solved.

column12: Method of conditioning an anion exchange membrane in an electrolysis cell
column13: A method of conditioning an anion exchange membrane (AEM) in an electrolysis cell is described. The anion exchange membrane (AEM) comprises non-hydroxide anions. The method comprises: providing an electrolysis cell comprising an anode, a cathode and an anion exchange membrane situated between the anode and the cathode. The anion exchange membrane is then contacted with a conditioning solution comprising hydroxide ions to replace at least some of the non-hydroxide anions with hydroxide anions. The AEM may comprise quaternary ammonium cations. The conditioning solution may comprise potassium hydroxide. A catalyst may be present between the electrode(s) and the membrane such as an hydrogen evolution reaction catalyst (HER) or oxygen evolution reaction catalyst (OER).

column12: Quaternary ammonium type polybiphenyl alkylene anion exchange membrane for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method of quaternary ammonium type polybiphenyl alkylene anion exchange membrane
column13: The invention discloses a quaternary ammonium type polybiphenyl alkylene anion exchange membrane for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method of the quaternary ammonium type polybiphenyl alkylene anion exchange membrane, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) biphenyl, 7-bromo-1, 1, 1-trifluoroheptane-2-ketone and 2, 2, 2-trifluoroacetophenone are subjected to Friedel-Crafts hydroxyalkylation reaction to obtain a polybiphenyl alkylene main chain; (2) dissolving the polybiphenyl alkylene prepared in the step (1), and respectively reacting with trimethylamine, pyridine and N-methylpiperidine to obtain corresponding ionomers; and (3) preparing the ionomer prepared in the step (2) into a solution, filtering, pouring into a polytetrafluoroethylene grinding tool, standing, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the quaternary ammonium type polybiphenyl alkylene anion exchange membrane for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. column12: Membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production devices, in particular to a membrane electrode for water electrolysis hydrogen production of an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method of the membrane electrode. column12: Shutdown protection system for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system and protection method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis systems, in particular to a shutdown protection system for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system and a protection method of the shutdown protection system. The invention discloses a shutdown protection system for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system. An alkali liquor circulation loop; the pure water supply unit is used for conveying pure water into the electrolysis chamber through the alkali liquor circulation loop so as to replace and/or dilute residual alkali liquor in the electrolytic bath; and the monitoring assembly is arranged on one side of the electrolytic bath, and the monitoring assembly is connected with the alkali liquor circulation loop, the pure water supply unit and the electrolysis system in the electrolytic bath through electric signals. The running state of the electrolysis system is obtained in real time through the monitoring assembly, and when the shutdown state is monitored, the pure water supply unit is triggered to convey pure water to the electrolysis chamber through the alkali liquor circulation loop, so that the membrane is prevented from being degraded due to the effect of alkali liquor, and the structural integrity of the anion exchange membrane is effectively protected.

column12: Combined anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system
column13: The invention provides a combined anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system which comprises a direct-current power supply, an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, a hydrogen side heat exchanger, an oxygen side heat exchanger, a gas-liquid separation device, a hydrogen washer, an oxygen washer, a hydrogen side pneumatic valve and an oxygen side pneumatic valve. After being subjected to gas-liquid separation by the gas-liquid separation device, hydrogen and oxygen respectively enter the hydrogen scrubber and the oxygen scrubber, are cooled and washed by the hydrogen scrubber and the oxygen scrubber to reduce the alkali content and the water content in the hydrogen and the oxygen, and are output to the hydrogen side pneumatic valve and the oxygen side pneumatic valve to be emptied or purified; the direct-current power supply and the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell form a water electrolysis hydrogen production module, and a plurality of water electrolysis hydrogen production modules are connected in parallel to form the water electrolysis hydrogen production system. According to the technical scheme, the electrolysis area of a single electrolytic cell of the water electrolysis hydrogen production system can be reduced, the gas production rate of water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment is increased, and the equipment investment cost is further reduced.

column13: The invention belongs to the field of hydrogen energy, and particularly relates to an anion exchange membrane containing an amide structure as well as a preparation method and application of the anion exchange membrane. column12: COATING OF ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANES
column13: The invention relates to the coating of anion exchange membranes with catalytically active substances. The catalytically actively coated anion exchange membranes are used in electrochemical cells, especially for water electrolysis. The problem addressed by the invention is that of specifying a process for coating an anion exchange membrane which can be conducted at relatively low temperatures. This problem is solved by a swelling step. Aside from the swelling step and the processing temperature, the sequence of the process according to the invention resembles a decal process. However, the use of the partly liquid swelling agent means that the process according to the invention can be considered to be a wet process. The process enables the processing of anion-conducting polymers at moderate temperatures. The anion-conducting polymers may be present in the anion exchange membrane and/or in the composition that is applied to the anion exchange membrane. The advantage of the process according to the invention is that it can be conducted at comparatively low temperatures, namely below 100°C.

column12: Branched polyaromatic piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a branched polyaromatic piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application. column12: A WATER ELECTROLYZER SYSTEM
column13: Disclosed herein is a spatially decoupled redox flow water electrolyzer, that has a hydrogen-producing catholyte section formed from a catholyte tank, having a cathode, and a hydrogen generation compartment, where the catholyte tank and the hydrogen generation compartment are fluidly connected to one another by a fluid pathway, so as to facilitate the circulation of a liquid catholyte from the catholyte tank to the hydrogen generation compartment and back to the catholyte tank and an oxygen-producing anolyte section formed from an anolyte tank, having an anode, and an oxygen producing compartment, where the anolyte tank and the oxygen producing compartment are fluidly connected to one another by a fluid pathway, so as to facilitate the circulation of a liquid anolyte from the anolyte tank to the oxygen producing compartment and back to the anolyte tank, an anion-exchange membrane is disposed between the catholyte and anolyte tanks and a current collector attached to the catholyte and anolyte tanks. column12: WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST
column13: A family of catalysts for oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in alkaline condition is disclosed. The catalysts utilize elements which are abundant on earth, leading to lower costs compared to IrO2 catalysts. The family of new catalysts comprises Ni, Fe, M, B, and O, where M is a metal from Group VIB, Group VIII, and elements 57-71 of the Periodic Table. The catalyst has a layered double hydroxide structure. Methods of making the catalysts are also described.

column12: Anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof

column12: Anion exchange membrane with integral asymmetric structure as well as preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane with an integral asymmetric structure as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to an ion exchange membrane as well as preparation and application thereof. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of high system tank voltage, low electrolysis efficiency and short service life when the conventional ion exchange membrane with a symmetrical structure is used for an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production system. The anion exchange membrane disclosed by the invention is composed of a chloromethylated polysulfone base membrane with an asymmetric structure and methacryloyloxyethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride grafted on the surface of the base membrane; wherein the asymmetric structure base membrane is composed of a compact surface layer and a lower supporting layer; the preparation method comprises the following steps: by taking chloromethylated polysulfone as a matrix, adding sulfonated polyetheretherketone and polyvinylpyrrolidone to form a casting solution, preparing a base membrane by an immersion precipitation phase conversion method, and grafting the methacryloyloxyethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride to the surface of the base membrane. When the membrane is used for electrolytic hydrogen production of an alkaline solution, the cell voltage is only 3.10 V under the current density of 1000 mA cm <-2 >, and the membrane can continuously and stably run for 100 hours and is used for the fields of electrolysis, electrodialysis and batteries.

column12: Preparation method of PPy-CS-DIM nanotube composite anion exchange membrane
column13: The invention belongs to the field of new energy and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a PPy-CS-DIM nanotube composite anion exchange membrane. According to the preparation method, a chemical oxidation method is adopted, methyl orange and ferric chloride are utilized to form a self-assembled nanotube template, and meanwhile, quaternized starch and 1, 2-dimethylimidazole are introduced to prepare the ternary composite nanotube based on polypyrrole. The PPy-CS-DIM nanotube has a unique confinement micropore effect, and an efficient and ordered hydroxyl ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the ionic conductivity of the membrane is greatly improved. The nanotube is added into a polymer OPBI substrate, and a high-performance OPBI anion exchange membrane can be prepared. By adjusting the doping content of the PPy-CS-DIM nanotube, the ionic conductivity of the OPBI membrane is optimized, and compared with a pure OPBI anion exchange membrane, the ionic conductivity of the obtained composite anion exchange membrane is remarkably improved.

column12: Management system for changing anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack and control method thereof
column13: The replacement management system for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack and a method for controlling the same are disclosed to replace a water electrolysis stack at an appropriate timing. The replacement management system for the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack comprises: a plurality of water electrolysis stacks arranged in parallel to produce hydrogen; and a control unit controlling the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. The control unit calculates a difference between a density measurement value of water and an electrolyte supplied to the plurality of water electrolysis stacks and a density measurement value of oxygen and the electrolyte discharged from the plurality of water electrolysis stacks to convert a calculated difference into an absolute value. When the absolute value is equal to or less than a set value, the control unit determines that a replacement target has a presence among the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. Furthermore, the control unit calculates a difference between temperature measurement values at a front end and a rear end of each of the water electrolysis stacks to convert a calculated difference into an absolute value. When the absolute value is equal to or less than the set value, the control unit determines a corresponding water electrolysis stack satisfying a condition as the replacement target, and operates an alarm signal so that a manager is capable of performing a replacement work.

column12: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis water oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials, and particularly relates to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly preparing a high-strength porous metal carrier, then comprehensively loading a catalytic material on the high-strength porous metal carrier to form a catalytic layer, then washing off the catalytic layer on one side of the high-strength porous metal carrier, and forming a conductive layer to obtain the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution electrode. The high-strength porous metal carrier has compression resistance, the stacking compression amount is small, the surface is smooth, and the contact resistance is small; the catalyst layer is in a sheet shape, has a high specific surface area and provides a large number of active sites for reaction; the conductive layer is made of fiber alloy and has conductivity close to that of pure nickel. The anion exchange membrane electrolysis water oxygen evolution electrode is assembled in an electrolysis stack, and when the cell voltage is 1.9 V, the current density of the stack reaches 4 A/cm < 2 >.

column12: Anion-exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode and efficient and rapid activation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis membrane electrode and an efficient and rapid activation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis. The method comprises the following steps: assembling an anode, a cathode and an anion exchange membrane into a single cell, and introducing an electrolyte; applying initial voltage to start the electrolytic tank; step 2, increasing the voltage step by step according to a preset voltage step length, keeping a preset time under each voltage step until a target voltage is reached, and forming an activation cycle; and repeatedly carrying out a plurality of activation cycles, monitoring the current change in real time in the activation process, calculating the current change rate under the same voltage step in two adjacent activation cycles, and stopping activation when the current change rate is smaller than a preset threshold value. According to the invention, the rapid and controllable activation of the membrane electrode is realized by combining the stepped circulating boost with the current change rate criterion, the activation time is remarkably shortened, the electrochemical impact is avoided, and the performance stability and consistency of the membrane electrode are improved.

column12: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalysts.The anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst is characterized in that graphene oxide serves as a carrier, cerium sulfide nano-particles are loaded on the surface of the graphene oxide, more active sites of a composite material are promoted to be exposed, and the stability of the composite material is improved; moreover, the loaded cerium sulfide nanoparticles effectively regulate and control the electronic structure on the surface of the graphene oxide, and the adsorption and desorption capabilities of the composite material on hydrogen atoms are improved, so that the activity of an electro-catalytic hydrogen evolution reaction is improved. column12: Composite anion-exchange membrane based on cationic group modified polyethylene supporting layer and preparation method of composite anion-exchange membrane
column13: The invention discloses a composite anion exchange membrane based on a cationic group modified polyethylene supporting layer and a preparation method of the composite anion exchange membrane. The composite anion exchange membrane is prepared by using an ultrathin porous polyethylene membrane which is irradiated by gamma rays and grafted with nitrogen-containing cationic monomers as a hydrophilic support layer and performing vacuum impregnation with an anion exchange resin solution. The composite anion exchange membrane is good in interface bonding and compact in structure, not only has excellent mechanical performance, ionic conductivity and dimensional stability and excellent alkali resistance, but also has an obvious price advantage compared with an existing anion exchange membrane; the method has wide application prospects in the fields of water electrolysis hydrogen production, fuel cells, electrochemical synthesis, flow batteries, electrodialysis and the like.

column12: High-surface-roughness anion exchange membrane based on radiation grafting and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, and discloses a radiation-grafting-based anion exchange membrane with high surface roughness and a preparation method thereof, polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), ethylene tetrafluoroethylene (ETFE), polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) and the like are used as main chains, aryl side chains containing quaternary ammonium cation groups are adopted, and the radiation-grafting-based anion exchange membrane with high surface roughness is prepared. column12: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production test system and test method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production testing, in particular to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production testing system and a testing method thereof. The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production test system. The hydrogen side gas-liquid separation device is arranged at one end of the electrolysis device and is communicated with the electrolytic cell, and a gas-liquid separation device is arranged in the hydrogen side gas-liquid separation device and is used for carrying out gas-liquid separation on hydrogen which is formed by electrolysis in the electrolytic cell and contains alkali liquor steam; and the oxygen alkali washing device is arranged at the other end of the electrolysis device, and the oxygen alkali washing device is communicated with the electrolysis tank so as to carry out alkali washing treatment on oxygen which is formed by electrolysis in the electrolysis tank and contains alkali liquor steam. A two-way alkali liquor recovery mechanism is adopted, the gas-liquid separation device is arranged on the hydrogen side, the alkali washing device is arranged on the oxygen side, and the problem that alkali liquor on the hydrogen side is lost due to traditional single-side alkali washing is solved.

column12: Polymer, cross-linked anion-exchange membrane and preparation method and application of cross-linked anion-exchange membrane
column13: The invention provides a polymer, a cross-linked anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the polymer and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane, aryl compounds, trifluoroketone compounds and N-methylpiperidone are polymerized to form a main chain, the main chain has excellent rigidity and flexibility, a quaternary ammonium salt alkenyl compound is introduced as a cross-linking agent, cross-linking is completed through heating in the membrane forming process, and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane is prepared. The quaternary ammonium salt side chain introduced into the side chain has excellent hydrophilic and hydrophobic phase separation characteristics. The polymer and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane have excellent oxidation-reduction resistance and alkali resistance, have the characteristics of stable physical and chemical properties, excellent ion flux, excellent mechanical properties (the elongation at break is greater than 60%) and simple process, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.

column12: Power-adjustable anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell based on sliding rods
column13: The invention discloses a power-adjustable anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell based on a sliding rod. The power-adjustable anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a gear sliding block mechanism and a plurality of small electrolytic chambers clamped between a cathode current collecting end plate and an anode current collecting end plate, the gear sliding block mechanism comprises a mounting seat, a connecting plate and a sliding rod, two ends of the connecting plate and the sliding rod are fixedly connected with the cathode current collecting end plate and the anode current collecting end plate, the mounting seat is in sliding connection with the connecting plate, and a rack is fixedly arranged on the connecting plate; an output shaft of the stepping motor is fixedly connected with a driving bevel gear, the mounting seat is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a driven bevel gear and a driven gear; the sliding rod comprises a plurality of conductive sliding rods which are sequentially arranged at intervals and fixedly connected through insulating rings, the sliding rods are slidably sleeved with conductive sliding rings, the conductive sliding rings are fixedly connected with the bottom face of the mounting base, bipolar plates of the electrolysis small chambers are fixedly connected with current collecting blocks, the current collecting blocks are fixedly connected with the conductive sliding rods, and voltage of the conductive sliding rings is conveyed to the current collecting blocks through the conductive sliding rods and conductive connecting rods. And the number of the small electrolysis tanks in actual operation can be changed.

column12: Anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis. The anion exchange membrane comprises a polyarylbiphenyl polymer matrix and LDH nanosheets dispersed in the matrix, the thickness of the LDH nanosheets is 5-20 nm, and the transverse size of the LDH nanosheets is 100-1000 nm. According to the anion exchange membrane disclosed by the invention, the specific alkali-resistant polyarylbiphenyl polymer is used as a substrate and is compounded with the LDH nanosheet with a specific size, so that the LDH nanosheet serving as an inorganic filler is well dispersed in a polymer matrix and plays a synergistic enhancement role, and the high-performance composite anion exchange membrane is obtained; the composite material has high ionic conductivity, low swelling rate and good mechanical properties, and can be widely applied to the field of hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis.

column12: Photo-curing anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a photocuring anion-exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of anion-exchange membranes and preparation thereof. The photoinitiator comprises the following components in parts by mass: 50-80 parts of an acrylate polymer matrix containing an epoxy group, 10-30 parts of an anion exchange group functional monomer, 1-5 parts of a photoinitiator, 2-10 parts of a cross-linking agent and 0.5-5 parts of an additive. The membrane shows excellent mechanical strength and chemical stability in hydrogen production through water electrolysis, the curing efficiency is improved by two times or more compared with a traditional process through a deuterated photo-initiation system of the membrane, the ionic conduction efficiency is remarkably enhanced through the synergistic effect of a three-dimensional cross-linked network and graphene filler, and the technical bottleneck that a traditional anion exchange membrane is prone to swelling and short in service life is solved.

column12: High-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of membrane materials. The high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane provided by the invention is obtained by carrying out self-polymerization on a branched monomer or carrying out copolymerization on the branched monomer, a biphenyl monomer and N-methyl-4-piperidone and then carrying out quaternization conversion. The free volume of the anion exchange membrane is larger than that of a linear polymer, so that the anion exchange membrane shows ultrahigh conductivity; due to a high-molecular-weight polymer main chain (Mn is greater than 100K), the polymer has excellent alkali-resistant stability and mechanical strength; meanwhile, the anion exchange membrane has low water absorption swelling rate and dimensional stability, is suitable for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and alkaline fuel cells, and has wide application prospects.

column12: Polypropylene-based cross-linked quaternized anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and discloses a polypropylene-based cross-linked quaternized anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and an application of the anion exchange membrane in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. Polypropylene is used as a polymer main chain, and benzyl chloride active reaction sites are given to an intermediate film through radiation grafting; further, accurate cross-linking is realized among polymer chain segments through a Menshutkin reaction. Two different flexible cross-linking agents are selected to respectively form different cross-linked networks, so that the defects of weak mechanical property and poor dimensional stability of an uncross-linked film are effectively overcome; and meanwhile, coupling optimization of ionic conductivity, mechanical properties and dimensional stability of the membrane material is realized by precisely regulating and controlling the amination and crosslinking ratio. The anion exchange membrane material shows excellent comprehensive performance and good application potential in related electrochemical application due to the structural matching of the main chain and the side chain and the synergistic balance of multiple gains and multiple properties of the crosslinking effect.

column12: Mesh electrode for alkaline electrolytic bath and anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath and preparation method of mesh electrode
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, in particular to a mesh electrode for an alkaline electrolytic cell (ALK) and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell (AEM) and a preparation method of the mesh electrode. A mesh electrode for an alkaline electrolytic cell and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is formed by weaving multi-element alloy wires, the expression of the components of the alloy wires is FeaCobNicCudTieTafHfgZrhAliMoj, and the atomic percent of the components meets the equation that a + b + c + d + e + f + g + h + i + j = 100 at%, and the content of each component is adjustable in a range of 0-55 at%. The number of knitting meshes of the electrode is 40-60, and the diameter of the alloy wire is 0.1-2.0 mm. The mesh electrode provided by the invention can be directly used for an ALK/AEM electrolytic cell, does not need structural adaptation or process adjustment, and has excellent catalytic activity and long-term operation stability.

column12: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and waste heat recovery system
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and waste heat recovery system. The system is composed of a water electrolysis hydrogen production system, a steam compression type refrigeration cycle system, a gas purification system and a waste heat recovery system. The water electrolysis hydrogen production system is used for electrolyzing water to produce hydrogen and oxygen; the steam compression type refrigeration cycle system comprises an evaporator, a compressor, a condenser and a throttle valve; the gas purification system is used for cooling and drying hydrogen to finally obtain hydrogen with qualified purity; cooling liquid in the waste heat recovery system absorbs heat released by the condenser, and high-temperature cooling liquid can be stored in the heat storage tank to be used for providing domestic hot water and heating and can enter the circulation heat exchanger through a pipeline to heat alkali liquor or pure water in a circulation loop. According to the invention, low-grade heat energy in the electrolysis process is converted into high-grade heat energy, and the high-grade heat energy is fully recycled, so that the electric energy consumption in the hydrogen purification process is reduced, and the adaptability of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system under the variable load working condition is improved.

column12: Norbornene-containing bis-benzocyclobutane polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane material containing norbornene dibenzocyclobutane polyaryl piperidine as well as a preparation method and application of the anion exchange membrane material, and relates to the field of anion exchange membrane materials for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. According to the invention, norbornene bis-benzocyclobutane is introduced into a polymer main chain of aromatic hydrocarbon and piperidone to form a distorted and difficult-to-rotate space structure. By adopting the technical scheme, the structural rigidity and larger free volume of a polymer skeleton are improved, the formation of a large number of microporous structures is promoted, the agglomeration of ion clusters is facilitated, more phase separation structures are formed, and the ionic conductivity of the membrane material is improved through the synergistic effect of the two, so that the membrane material is more stable in performance. And meanwhile, the problem of relatively poor dimensional stability caused by excessive water absorption of the membrane material is inhibited, and the prepared anion exchange membrane has a wide application prospect in the field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis.

column12: Membrane electrode assembly of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and preparation method of membrane electrode assembly
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a membrane electrode assembly of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the membrane electrode assembly. Comprising the following steps: step 1, adding modified titanium dioxide, an epoxy group cross-linking agent and a modified polymer into toluene, and homogenizing; casting by using a phase inversion method, and carrying out cross-linking treatment at 75-85 DEG C for 6-8 hours to obtain an anion exchange membrane; step 2, respectively spraying cathode catalyst slurry and anode catalyst slurry on two sides of the anion exchange membrane, drying and curing to form a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer; a cathode protection layer is attached to the surface of the cathode catalyst layer through vacuum adsorption, an anode protection layer is attached to the surface of the anode catalyst layer through vacuum adsorption, and rolling is conducted; therefore, the membrane electrode assembly of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is obtained.

column12: Covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane is an organic membrane which is formed by taking quaternized polybiphenyl piperidyl QAPIP as a membrane matrix and taking a mixed methyl grafted COF-TpBpy framework or a functionalized ionic liquid impregnated COF-TpBpy framework as an ion channel. A modified COF-TpBpy framework ion channel is introduced into quaternized polybiphenyl piperidine to construct the novel covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane, an ion migration channel can be remarkably widened, a transmission path can be optimized, the ion transmission efficiency of a membrane material can be improved, and a technical scheme with higher efficiency is provided for the fields of hydrogen production through water electrolysis and the like.

column12: A PURE HYDROGEN GAS PRODUCTION SYSTEM AND METHOD
column13: The invention relates to a pure hydrogen gas production system (A) for use in hydrogen production technologies, including applications such as energy storage, fuel cells, and industrial chemical processes. The system (A) is characterized by including at least one top cover (10) that encloses the upper portion of the system and protects its internal components from external factors, and at least one bottom cover (20) that encloses the lower portion of the system, ensuring the stable and secure positioning of the electrolysis cell. It also features a water inlet (30) that allows the introduction of water containing potassium hydroxide into the system (A), at least one anode (60) functioning as the positive electrode, and at least one cathode (70) functioning as the negative electrode during the electrolysis process. Conductive plates (100) are included to ensure efficient transmission of electrical current to the electrolysis cell, along with at least one sealing element (101) positioned between the conductive plates (100) to ensure the liquid- tightness of the electrolysis cell. Furthermore, an anion exchange membrane (90) with high selectivity and permeability is positioned within the void (102) of the conductive plates (100). This membrane purifies the HHO gas generated by the electric current passing between the anode (60) and the cathode (70) during electrolysis, separating water molecules and extracting pure hydrogen gas.

column12: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system and operation control method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of AEMWE electrolytic cell hydrogen production, and discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system and an operation control method thereof. According to the invention, an AEM electrolytic bath is provided, and an anode electrode of the AEM electrolytic bath adopts a nickel-iron layered double hydroxide catalyst taking nickel felt or foamed nickel as a carrier; establishing a current density-Faraday efficiency relation model of the AEM electrolytic cell; based on the current density-Faraday efficiency relation model, calculating the comprehensive Faraday efficiency under the fluctuation current input condition; and according to the comprehensive Faraday efficiency, operating parameters of the AEM electrolytic cell are adjusted, and the hydrogen production efficiency and the safety performance are optimized. column12: Crosslinking type polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a cross-linked polyarylpiperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes. According to the anion exchange membrane, polyarylpiperidine is used as a framework, a crown ether structure and a cross-linked network are introduced, and the technical problem that the conductivity and dimensional stability of hydroxyl in an existing anion exchange membrane are difficult to balance is solved. The anion exchange membrane comprises a repetitive unit with a specific structure, and is prepared through Friedel-Crafts super acid catalytic polymerization, Menshutkin reaction functionalization and Michael addition reaction crosslinking. And the method has a wide industrial application prospect.

column12: Ionic polymer based on flexible main chain, anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides an ionic polymer based on a flexible main chain, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. column12: Side chain type polyaryl anion-exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof and anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell
column13: The invention relates to a side chain type polyaryl anion-exchange membrane, a preparation method and application thereof and an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy. The preparation method of the side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: reacting a side chain type polyaryl skeleton polymer with a quaternization reagent to obtain a side chain type polyaryl anion polymer; the side-chain type polyaryl anion polymer is subjected to membrane forming, and the side-chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane is obtained. According to the invention, a heteroatom-free polyaryl structure is selected as a main chain, and a super-acid-catalyzed Friedel-Crafts reaction is adopted for polymerization, so that the high-molecular polymer is obtained; the cationic functional group is a piperidine cationic functional group with excellent alkali stability; the piperidine cation functional group is connected with the polyaryl main chain through a long alkyl chain. According to the invention, a long alkyl chain is adopted to combine a polyaryl skeleton with a piperidine cation functional group, and a hydrophilic/hydrophobic microphase separation structure is constructed in the membrane, so that the conductivity of hydroxyl ions is remarkably improved while the alkali stability and the size stability are improved.

column12: Double-conduction network composite anion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and electrolysis device
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy materials, in particular to a double-conduction network composite anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and an electrolyzer, and the double-conduction network composite anion exchange membrane comprises a quaternized polymer matrix; amino groups on the surface of the amino-functionalized graphene oxide NH2-GO are connected with quaternary ammonium groups of the quaternized polymer through covalent bonds; the NH2-GO is used for constructing an ion-electron double-conduction network in the membrane. According to the technical scheme, an ion (OH <->)-electron (e <->) double-conduction network is constructed through covalent bond connection of amino-functionalized graphene oxide (NH2-GO) and a quaternized polymer matrix, and meanwhile, CeO2 nanoparticles are added as a free radical scavenger, so that the ionic conductivity, the mechanical strength and the durability of the membrane are remarkably improved. Experimental results show that compared with a traditional physical blend membrane, the conductivity of the membrane can reach 117.7 mS/cm at room temperature, the tensile strength reaches 57 MPa, and the membrane shows excellent comprehensive performance.

column12: Branched anion exchange membrane based on tetraphenyl ethylene as well as preparation method and application of branched anion exchange membrane
column13: The invention discloses a tetraphenylethylene-based branched anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, tetraphenylethylene is used as a branching agent, the tetraphenylethylene, an aromatic monomer and piperidone are subjected to superacid catalytic polymerization to prepare polyaryl piperidine with a star-shaped branched structure, and then quaternary ammonium functionalization and post-treatment are performed to obtain the branched anion exchange membrane (AEM). The branched structure can reduce the stacking density of polymer chains in the membrane, form a high-proportion free volume to improve the water absorption rate, reduce the OH <-> transmission resistance and improve the ionic conductivity; the rigid aromatic branched skeleton can inhibit excessive water swelling of the membrane; the free volume fraction of the membrane can be optimized by regulating and controlling the molar percentage of tetraphenyl ethylene in the copolymerized aromatic monomer, the AEM with high ionic conductivity and dimensional stability is obtained, and the AEM can be applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis cell.

column12: Cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: firstly, taking styrene and p-chloromethyl styrene as monomers, and obtaining a copolymer through bulk polymerization under the action of an initiator; the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a copolymer from polystyrene, then preparing a membrane casting solution from the copolymer and 1, 4-diazabicyclo [2.2. 2] octane, casting to form a membrane, then immersing the obtained membrane into a trimethylamine aqueous solution for complete quaternization, and finally treating in a KOH aqueous solution to obtain the cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane. The invention provides an application of the cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane in alkaline electrolyzed water. The anion exchange membrane is simple in synthesis process, reagents are cheap and easy to obtain, the contradiction between the OH <-> conductivity and the size stability of a traditional anion exchange membrane can be greatly balanced, and meanwhile the anion exchange membrane has high alkaline stability and shows excellent electrolytic performance in alkaline electrolyzed water.

column12: Polyaralkyl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a polyaralkyl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. A highly hydrophobic perfluoroalkyl side chain and a hydrophilic ureido side chain are introduced into a main chain, and an ion transmission channel is constructed by utilizing hydrophilic and hydrophobic thermodynamic incompatibility; and the formation of the ion channel facilitates the transmission of hydroxyl ions. A hydrogen bond network formed among introduced ureido also promotes efficient transmission of ions, so that the conductivity is improved. On the aspect of mechanical property, on one hand, the lower ion exchange capacity (IEC) can inhibit excessive swelling, and the mechanical property in a wet state is improved; on the other hand, a constructed hydrogen bond is introduced into ureido, so that the interaction force between polymer molecular chains is enhanced, the interchain entanglement is improved, and the anion exchange membrane is endowed with better mechanical properties. The invention effectively solves the problem of mutual restriction effect between high ionic conductivity and wet mechanical properties of the anion-exchange membrane in the existing anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis tank.

column12: Composite anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a composite anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The membrane comprises a porous substrate and a covalent organic framework functional layer which grows in situ and is bonded on the porous substrate, the functional layer is provided with an ordered skeleton formed by periodically connecting aromatic units through dynamic covalent bonds, and a quaternary ammonium salt type anion exchange group is grafted on the skeleton. The preparation method mainly comprises the steps of performing in-situ polycondensation on a porous substrate to form a precursor, performing in-situ crystallization to construct an ordered skeleton, performing in-situ reduction to enhance stability, performing in-situ quaternization to graft functional groups and the like. According to the invention, through compounding of the porous substrate and the rigid ordered COF skeleton, high mechanical strength and low swelling characteristics are ingeniously combined with high ionic conductivity brought by regular pore channels and grafting groups, and the technical bottleneck that mechanical properties and electrochemical properties of a traditional anion exchange membrane are difficult to consider at the same time is successfully solved. The obtained membrane material shows excellent performance in water electrolysis application, and has a wide application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: High-alkali-resistant anion exchange membrane with gradient pore structure and application of anion exchange membrane in hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a gradient pore structure high-alkali-resistance anion exchange membrane which is characterized in that brominated polyphenyl ether is used as a base material of the anion exchange membrane, the base material is dissolved in N-methyl pyrrolidone to form a membrane casting solution, and the membrane casting solution is mixed with a solvent to form the anion exchange membrane. Carrying out quaternization reaction on the membrane casting solution to obtain a quaternized brominated polyphenyl ether membrane casting solution; the anion exchange membrane adopts a gradient pore-foaming agent system to form a gradient pore structure, the gradient pore-foaming agent system comprises polyethylene glycol with different particle sizes, and the polyethylene glycol is selected from at least two of polyethylene glycol 2000, polyethylene glycol 4000 and polyethylene glycol 8000; the total thickness of the membrane is from 120 microns to 160 microns, and the porosity is from 35% to 42%. A continuous gradient pore channel structure of lower-layer macropores, middle-layer mesopores and upper-layer small pores is constructed by regulating and controlling the particle size, the adding amount and the pouring process of the pore-foaming agent. The structure can form a synergistic effect of a rapid mass transfer channel and an ion selective barrier.

column12: Piperidine anion exchange membrane containing anthracene and derivatives thereof, preparation method and application of alkaline membrane electrolysis water tank
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion exchange membranes, and discloses a piperidine anion exchange membrane containing anthracene and derivatives thereof, a preparation method of the piperidine anion exchange membrane and application of an alkaline membrane electrolysis water tank. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing piperidine type trimonomer polymers containing anthracene and derivatives thereof in different proportions; then, carrying out quaternization on the polymers by directly taking piperidone of the polymers as functional sites to obtain a membrane material; and preparing the membrane. According to the invention, by introducing anthracene and derivative monomers thereof and utilizing a pi-pi accumulation effect, a functional group anchored on a main chain is induced to self-assemble, so that the formation of a microphase separation structure can be promoted, the water-resistant plasticizing capability of a hydrophobic phase is enhanced, and the swelling of a membrane is inhibited. By adjusting the proportion of the anthracene and the derivative monomer thereof to the p-terphenyl monomer, the rigidity of the polymer can be enhanced, the free volume of the polymer can be expanded, and the dimensional stability and the ion transport capacity of the polymer can be improved. The prepared membrane has good alkali stability and mechanical strength and can be applied to alkaline membrane electrolyzed water.

column12: Multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method of the multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: carrying out polycondensation on an aromatic compound, N-methylpiperidone and 3-quinuclidinone hydrochloride under the catalysis of superacid to obtain a polymer intermediate; carrying out quaternization reaction on the polymer intermediate, end-halogenated perfluoro long-chain alkane and methyl iodide, and introducing a hydrophobic side chain to obtain membrane powder; and finally, dissolving the film powder and coating to form the film. The 3-quinuclidone is introduced to participate in copolymerization, so that the molecular weight and the alkali resistance of a main chain of the polymer are effectively improved; meanwhile, by introducing a perfluoroalkane hydrophobic side chain, a hydrophilic-hydrophobic phase separation structure is constructed, and an effective ion transmission channel is formed. The obtained multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane has the advantages of low swelling ratio, high mechanical strength, high chemical stability, strong alkali resistance, low membrane resistance and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.

column12: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system and hydrogen production method
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system and a hydrogen production method. column12: Anion exchange membrane water electrolyser catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolyser catalysts, and discloses a preparation method and application of a high-activity AEMWE catalyst. According to the method, metal foam is used as a conductive substrate, a cluster-shaped staggered FeCo-MOG nanoparticle array grows in situ through a solvothermal method, noble metal nanoclusters are anchored on the surface of the FeCo-MOG nanoparticle array, and then low-temperature solid-phase chemical deposition modification is performed to obtain the noble metal-FeCoP (or FeCoS and FeCoSe) composite catalyst rich in defect structure. column12: Nickel-iron oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode for anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and rapid construction method of nickel-iron oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode
column13: The invention provides a ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis and a rapid construction method of the ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode. The rapid construction method of the electrode comprises the following steps: placing pretreated foamed ferronickel in a hydrochloric acid aqueous solution for electrochemical etching, and then washing and drying to obtain the ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode for anion exchange membrane electrolysis water. According to the invention, the anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode is rapidly constructed within several minutes by adopting a one-step method. According to the method, porous foamed ferronickel is used as a gas diffusion layer, in an ultralow-concentration hydrochloric acid solution, an anode electric field is constructed on an electrode/electrolyte interface, the chloride ion adsorption effect is enhanced, an acid environment is coupled, the surface of the foamed ferronickel is directly etched, and the ferronickel-based catalyst with the high specific surface area is synthesized on a substrate in situ. The preparation method is rapid, controllable, simple, low in cost and mild in synthesis condition, and the catalyst has excellent catalytic activity and stability.

column12: Preparation method and application of membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, which comprises the following steps: dissolving a nickel source, an iron source and a magnesium source in deionized water, and adopting an ultrasonic coprecipitation method to obtain a Ni-Fe-Mg LDH material; preparing an anode electrode material from the Ni-Fe-Mg LDH material, conductive carbon black, a dispersing agent and a binding agent; the preparation method comprises the following steps: synthesizing ultrathin Ti3C2Tx nanosheet modified foamed nickel through a stripping etching method, marking the ultrathin Ti3C2Tx nanosheet modified foamed nickel as MXene (at) NF, and carrying out constant-current electrodeposition by taking the MXene (at) NF as a cathode to obtain a cathode electrode material; the anode electrode material and the cathode electrode material are prepared into an anode electrode and a cathode electrode, and then the anode electrode, the cathode electrode, an anion exchange membrane and a current collector are subjected to hot press molding to obtain the membrane electrode. column12: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis device
column13: The utility model discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis device, and relates to the technical field of electrolysis devices. column12: CO2 corrosion resistant high-stability anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof

column13: The invention relates to an application of ruthenium-based pyrochlore in hydrogen production of an alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, which comprises the following steps: providing ruthenium-based pyrochlore Pb2M2-xRuxO7, in which M is Fe, Co, Ni, Cu or Zn, 0 lt; xlt; 2; ruthenium-based pyrochlore and the first mixed solution are mixed and then subjected to ball milling, and first slurry is obtained; removing the first mixed solution in the first slurry to obtain ball-milled ruthenium-based pyrochlore; mixing and dissolving the ball-milled ruthenium-based pyrochlore and carbon powder in a second mixed solution, and adding a dispersing agent for barreling to obtain second slurry; and ultrasonically spraying the second slurry on an anion exchange membrane to serve as an oxygen evolution anode. column12: Hybrid water electrolysis system
column13: An integrated water electrolysis system comprises: a high concentration electrolyte tank; a low concentration electrolyte tank which receives an electrolyte of a first concentration from the high concentration electrolyte tank and dilutes the same with an electrolyte of a second concentration; an alkali water electrolysis stack which receives the electrolyte of the first concentration from the high concentration electrolyte tank; an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack which receives the electrolyte of the second concentration from the low concentration electrolyte tank and generates hydrogen; and a dryer which removes moisture of first hydrogen generated in the alkali water electrolysis stack and second hydrogen generated in the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack to discharge dry hydrogen. The integrated water electrolysis system can provide a water electrolysis system capable of using both an alkali water electrolysis method capable of producing a large amount of hydrogen at a low price and an anion exchange membrane method capable of producing high-purity hydrogen at a relatively low cost using a non-noble metal catalyst.

column12: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis water/seawater hydrogen production catalyst, preparation method, electrolytic bath and electrolysis method
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water/seawater hydrogen production catalyst, a preparation method, an electrolytic bath and an electrolysis method. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out ultrasonic cleaning and vacuum drying on foamed nickel to obtain pretreated foamed nickel; s2, immersing the pretreated foamed nickel into the deposition liquid, performing deposition preparation by adopting a cathode cyclic voltammetry deposition method under a three-electrode system, taking out and cleaning the deposited foamed nickel, and performing vacuum drying to obtain nickel-cobalt-manganese hydrotalcite; s3, putting the obtained nickel-cobalt-manganese hydrotalcite into a reaction kettle filled with a selenylation solution, putting the reaction kettle into a drying oven, carrying out heat preservation reaction, naturally cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, washing, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain a nickel-cobalt-manganese selenide precursor; and S4, putting the obtained nickel cobalt manganese selenide precursor into a plasma cleaning machine, and treating the front surface and the back surface with plasma to obtain the nickel cobalt manganese selenide. The catalyst not only has excellent seawater electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalytic activity, but also has excellent oxygen evolution catalytic activity.

column12: Preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively dissolving a soluble nickel salt and a soluble cobalt salt in deionized water, mixing the two solutions, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to prepare a precursor reaction solution; adding 85% phosphoric acid solution and 98% sulfuric acid solution into the precursor reaction solution, and shearing; putting the obtained solution into a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, reacting under a high-temperature condition, and centrifuging, cleaning and drying to obtain a catalyst precursor after the reaction; and calcining the catalyst precursor in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst. The method has the advantages that a hydrothermal calcination synthesis method is adopted, phosphorus and sulfur are introduced in the preparation process, the non-noble metal AEM water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst is synthesized, the electron conduction capacity of the catalyst is remarkably improved, and the catalytic activity and stability of the catalyst are improved.

column12: Composite self-supporting anode for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and preparation method of composite self-supporting anode
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, in particular to a composite self-supporting anode for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the composite self-supporting anode. The composite self-supporting anode for the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a self-supporting substrate, an oxygen evolution catalytic layer and an electronic insulation platinum-based hydrogen elimination layer which are sequentially stacked, the oxygen evolution catalytic layer is loaded on the self-supporting substrate, and the electronic insulation platinum-based hydrogen elimination layer is loaded on the oxygen evolution catalytic layer. According to the composite self-supporting anode for the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, an electronic path between a dehydrogenation catalyst and an anode conductive substrate is thoroughly blocked, the risk that the dehydrogenation catalyst becomes a new hydrogen source is fundamentally avoided, and stable control over the hydrogen concentration in oxygen and collaborative improvement of the electrolytic efficiency are achieved; and meanwhile, the three-layer structure has a synergistic effect, the dual functions of low hydrogen content in oxygen and efficient oxygen evolution are considered, the mechanical strength is high, the compatibility is high, and a traditional anode can be directly replaced without greatly transforming an electrolytic cell.

column12: Crosslinking type polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a cross-linked polyaryl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method includes the steps that an aromatic compound and a nitrogen heterocyclic ketone compound are condensed to obtain a polymer intermediate, a terminal alkenyl structure cross-linking site is introduced in the quaternization process, ethyl acetoacetate is additionally added in the membrane scraping process, and the cross-linked polyaryl anion exchange membrane is obtained. And completing crosslinking in a hydroxyl ion replacement process to obtain the anion exchange membrane with high crosslinking degree. The participation of ethyl acetoacetate can make up for the defect of low crosslinking degree in the alkenyl free radical reaction process, and the crosslinking in the hydroxyl ion replacement stage is beneficial to the construction of a stable high-crosslinking-degree two-dimensional membrane structure; after alkali soaking, ethyl acetoacetate is hydrolyzed, and attached hydrophilic groups can effectively increase the hydrophilicity of the ion exchange membrane and reduce the membrane resistance. The cross-linked polyaryl anion exchange membrane has the advantages of low swelling coefficient, excellent mechanical property, high conductivity, stable chemical property, strong alkali resistance and low membrane resistance, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.

column12: Preparation method of modified polyphenyl ether anion exchange membrane with multiple ion transport sites
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a modified polyphenyl ether anion exchange membrane with multiple ion transport sites, and aims to solve the technical problems of low ionic conductivity and insufficient dimensional stability of the existing anion exchange membrane. The core innovation is as follows: grafting modification is performed on polyphenyl ether (PPO) by adopting an imidazole grafting agent with brominated sites, and a large number of quaternary ammonium cation groups are firstly constructed through reaction of imidazole groups and brominated polyphenyl ether (BPPO); the subsequently introduced cross-linking agent has dual reaction activity, not only can be subjected to cross-linking reaction with a BPPO long chain to form a network structure, but also can be further subjected to quaternization reaction with bromination sites of imidazole groups, and a large number of quaternary ammonium cation groups are additionally generated through a'grafting pre-modification and cross-linking dual reaction 'synergistic mechanism. The ionic conductivity of the prepared anion exchange membrane can reach 88.6 mS/cm to 138 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C, the membrane thickness is uniform (114-148 microns), the process is simple, industrial amplification is easy, and the anion exchange membrane is suitable for electrochemical devices such as water electrolysis hydrogen production, fuel cells and the like.

column12: A SYSTEM FOR PRODUCING CLEAN HYDROGEN AND CLEAN HYDROGEN DERIVED PRODUCTS USING WATER ELECTROLYSIS AND TIME CORRELATED RENEWABLE POWER
column13: A system for producing clean hydrogen and clean hydrogen derived products using water electrolysis and time correlated renewable power whereby the operation of the electrolysis is optimized for using time correlated renewable power amongst other factors. The system includes a hydrogen production unit that uses an electrolyzer to produce hydrogen from water and electricity, where the electricity is delivered via a connection to the electrical grid and/or behind the meter renewables and whereby a control unit manages the production of hydrogen based on the attributes of the renewable power, including time correlation and other factors. column12: Preparation method and application of anti-reverse current self-supporting electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an electrode, in particular to a preparation method and application of an anti-reverse current self-supporting electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production. The self-supporting (NiCoFe) 9S8 electrode is constructed by adopting a directional solid-phase synthesis strategy to overcome the challenge of performance degradation of the electrolytic cell. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, depositing a precursor solution of FeS2 and CoCl2 on a nickel felt substrate, and then carrying out annealing treatment to obtain uniformly grown (NiCoFe) 9S8; the method not only ensures uniform distribution of multiple metal components, but also constructs firm chemical bonding and efficient charge transfer between the catalyst layer and the conductive substrate through solid-phase interface reaction, and effectively avoids interface impedance caused by introduction of an additional binder. Therefore, high-current-density water electrolysis hydrogen production under intermittent fluctuation power supply is realized. In 1M KOH, the cell voltage is almost not attenuated when the electrode stably operates for 2000h at 500mAcm <-2 >.

column12: Gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production as well as preparation and application of gas diffusion cathode
