column12: Multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX and method for realizing coupled hydrogen production by using same
column13: The invention discloses a multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX and a method for realizing coupled hydrogen production by using the catalyst. According to the invention, the multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX with high stability and high performance is prepared by constructing V-doped VSA-CoNX, and the catalyst can realize hydrogen production by coupling multiple anion exchange membrane electrolytic cells. Particularly, when VSA-CoNX is used as an anode and a cathode, and hydrogen is produced by coupling a hydrazine assembled anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) electrolytic bath at ampere-level current density (1A cm <-2 >), only 0.21 V ultra-low voltage is needed, which means that the hydrazine assisted AEMWE is used for producing the same amount of hydrogen, only 11.17% of energy consumption of traditional water electrolysis is needed, only 0.506 kWhNm <-3 > H2 is needed, and the hydrogen production efficiency is greatly improved. Therefore, the hydrogen production cost is greatly reduced to 0.11 dollars per kilogram. Therefore, the multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX disclosed by the invention can be used for remarkably reducing the hydrogen production cost. In addition, experiments prove that the degradation rate of the hydrazine-containing electrolyte can exceed 95% within two hours, which shows that the hydrazine-containing electrolyte also has excellent wastewater degradation capacity.

column12: Branched quinine-based polymer, preparation method and application of branched quinine-based polymer in anion exchange membrane
column13: The invention discloses a branched quinine-based polymer, a preparation method and application of the branched quinine-based polymer in an anion exchange membrane, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy utilization and high polymer material preparation. The branched quinine-based polymer comprises a quinine ring structural unit, an aromatic structural unit, a crosslinking structural unit and a functional structural unit R1, and is applied to preparation of an anion exchange membrane. The technical limitation of single performance optimization of an existing anion exchange membrane is broken through, a high-steric-hindrance quinine cation group and a planar three-dimensional/stereoscopic four-dimensional branched cross-linked structure are subjected to molecular-level organic combination, triple technical cooperation of an ether-bond-free polymer skeleton, a quinine steric hindrance effect and branched structure free volume regulation and control is realized, and the high-performance anion exchange membrane is prepared. The industrial common problem that alkali resistance, ionic conductivity and mechanical strength of an existing membrane material are difficult to consider at the same time is solved from the molecular structure design level; the alkali-resistant stable operation time and the conductivity retention rate achieve qualitative breakthrough, the comprehensive performance is excellent, and the composite material is widely applied to hydrogen energy conversion devices such as alkaline fuel cells and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: Six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
column13: The invention discloses a six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the field of alkaline fuel cells and electrolyzed water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: introducing tri (4-carbazole-9-yl phenyl) amine with six branching sites into a polymer main chain as a branching unit, and carrying out Friedel-Crafts alkylation copolymerization on the branched unit, p-terphenyl and N-methyl-4-piperidone under the catalysis of superacid to prepare a six-arm star-shaped branched polymer main chain; and performing quaternization on a piperidine ring in the main chain through a Michaku reaction to obtain the target anion exchange membrane. According to the star-shaped branched structure disclosed by the invention, the free volume in the membrane is obviously increased, and a micro-phase separation structure with larger size and stronger connectivity is induced to be formed; the anion exchange membrane has high hydroxyl conductivity, excellent alkali stability, good mechanical performance and outstanding fuel cell and water electrolysis performance, and has wide application prospects in the field of electrochemical energy devices.

column12: Polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, particularly relates to preparation of a polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer and a high-stability anion exchange membrane prepared from the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, and further discloses a preparation method and application of the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer. According to the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, a full-carbon-chain skeleton structure is adopted, a functional group, namely carbonyl, connected with an electron-rich benzene ring is migrated from a piperidine-containing ring to the fourth site or/and other sites of the piperidine ring, and polymerization of the aldehyde group and aromatic hydrocarbon is used for replacing traditional polymerization of ketone group and aromatic hydrocarbon, so that the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer is obtained. The piperidine ring is suspended outside the aryl main chain in the polymer, the rigid structure of the piperidine ring is reserved, and the anion transmission rate and chemical stability are further improved. According to the polymer structure, modification of the polymer is realized by using strategies such as copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, hyperbranched and the like, and the polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed.

column12: Hybrid cross-linked structure high ion conduction anion exchange membrane and application thereof in hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a hybrid cross-linked structure high ion conduction anion exchange membrane and application thereof in alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production, PEEK is dissolved in 98% concentrated sulfuric acid, stirring is performed for 1 h at 50 DEG C until complete dissolution, 1, 4-dibromobutane is added, the molar ratio of PEEK to 1, 4-dibromobutane is 1: 1.2-1.5, stirring is performed for 1 h at the temperature of 50 DEG C, stirring is performed for 1 h at the temperature of 50 DEG C until complete dissolution is achieved, and the hybrid cross-linked structure high ion conduction anion exchange membrane is obtained. Raising the temperature to 60 DEG C and reacting for 8 hours; and after the reaction is finished, pouring the reaction system into deionized water, precipitating, filtering to obtain a faint yellow solid, repeatedly washing with deionized water until the filtrate is neutral, and carrying out vacuum drying at 60 DEG C for 12 hours to obtain the QPEEK with the quaternization degree of 1.2-1.5 mmol/g. The amino-functionalized nano silicon dioxide can form hydrogen-bond interaction with a substrate quaternary ammonium group, so that the organic-inorganic interface compatibility is improved, the interface resistance is reduced, the ion transmission path is optimized, the ion conduction efficiency of the membrane is remarkably improved, and the core requirement of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water on rapid ion migration is met.

column12: Solid electrolyte membrane for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolyzed water and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a solid electrolyte membrane for hydrogen production from alkaline electrolyzed water and a preparation method and application thereof, the solid electrolyte membrane comprises an anion exchange membrane and coatings arranged on the two sides of the anion exchange membrane, and a'coating-anion exchange membrane-coating 'sandwich composite structure is formed; the coating includes a mixture of a thermoplastic resin and hydrophilic inorganic nanoparticles. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively preparing coating slurry and anion exchange membrane slurry; coating the coating slurry on a transfer printing substrate, and drying to obtain a transfer printing substrate/coating; coating the coating slurry and the anion exchange membrane slurry on a transfer printing substrate in sequence, and drying to obtain a transfer printing substrate/coating/anion exchange membrane; and thermal transfer printing. Compared with the prior art, swelling deformation and damage of the anion exchange membrane can be effectively prevented, the mechanical property and stability of the anion exchange membrane are improved, and meanwhile the problem that the air tightness of the composite membrane is limited is solved.

column12: Novel anion exchange membrane photoelectrocatalytic water decomposition hydrogen production reactor and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar energy photoelectrocatalysis water decomposition hydrogen production, and discloses a novel anion exchange membrane photoelectrocatalysis water decomposition hydrogen production reactor and a preparation method thereof. An end plate, a cathode current collector, a cathode runner plate, a FeCoNi cathode, an anion exchange membrane, an anode current collector, an alpha-Fe2O3 photo-anode, quartz glass and an anode runner plate are sequentially attached to the reactor from back to front; a runner of the cathode plate is formed in the middle of the anode current collector; the FeCoNi cathode is directly and tightly attached to the alpha-Fe2O3 photo-anode through the anion exchange membrane; an optical window is formed in the middle of the anode runner plate, and the quartz glass is attached to the inner side of the optical window. The number of bubbles can be reduced and the diameter of the bubbles can be reduced by utilizing fluid shear force through the electrolyte flow adjusting function of the reactor. The invention provides a unique reactor design thought for improving the photoelectrochemical performance under high concentration.

column12: Anion exchange membrane oxygen evolution reaction catalyst and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane oxygen evolution reaction catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a water/isopropanol binary mixed solution containing nickel salt, ferric salt and ammonium fluoride as a solution A; preparing a water/isopropanol binary mixed solution containing potassium hydroxide and potassium carbonate as a solution B; and dropwise adding the solution B into the solution A at a constant speed under the conditions of normal pressure, 25 DEG C and stirring, curing, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain the NiFe-based layered double hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst. Controllable coprecipitation at normal pressure and low temperature is achieved through the synergistic effect of the water/isopropanol binary solvent, NH4F regulation and control and the KOH/K2CO3 compound alkali source, and the obtained catalyst is loose in morphology, rich in active sites and excellent in charge transmission performance. The method is simple in process, easy in parameter control and clear in amplification path, and the prepared catalyst is used for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis anode oxygen evolution reaction and has low overpotential and high stability.

column12: Anion exchange polymer and application thereof in water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, and particularly relates to an anion exchange polymer and application thereof in a membrane electrode for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. column12: High-stability membrane electrode and preparation method thereof, and water electrolyser applying high-stability membrane electrode
column13: The invention provides a high-stability membrane electrode, a preparation method of the high-stability membrane electrode and a water electrolyser applying the high-stability membrane electrode. The high-stability membrane electrode comprises an anode gas diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode gas diffusion layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the anode catalyst layer is prepared by the following steps: S1, mixing a nickel ferrite catalyst, polytetrafluoroethylene, an anion exchange membrane ionomer and a solvent, and uniformly stirring to prepare nickel ferrite catalyst slurry; and S2, coating the anode gas diffusion layer with the nickel ferrite catalyst slurry, performing drying to obtain a membrane electrode intermediate, placing the membrane electrode intermediate in inert gas, and performing heat preservation at the heat preservation temperature of 300-500 DEG C for 5-60 minutes to obtain an anode catalyst layer. The membrane electrode provided by the invention is good in structural stability and excellent in water electrolysis catalytic performance, a water electrolysis bath applying the membrane electrode can keep long-time operation, and the hydrogen production efficiency is high.

column12: Method for activation pretreatment of water electrolysis electrodes
column13: The present invention relates to a pretreatment activation method for improving the performance of a water electrolysis electrode using pure water as an electrolyte and using an anion exchange membrane. column12: Magnetic field assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production device
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a magnetic field assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production device which comprises an anode plate and a cathode plate, spiral flow channels are formed in the opposite faces of the anode plate and the cathode plate, the lower end of the anode plate is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, and the lower end of the cathode plate is fixedly connected with a transverse plate. The transverse plate is movably connected with the connecting plate; a limiting mechanism is separated from a limiting hole by pulling a pull ring, an anode plate and a cathode plate are separated, meanwhile, a liquid guide mechanism slides out, electrolyte left in a spiral flow channel is guided and discharged, the electrolyte is prevented from falling onto the surface of an electromagnetic coil, and an old catalyst and an anion exchange membrane are taken down, so that the service life of the catalyst is prolonged. And after a new catalyst and the anion exchange membrane are mounted on the anode plate, the anode plate is pushed to be in contact with the cathode plate, so that the limiting mechanism is clamped into the limiting hole again, and the operation is convenient and efficient.

column12: Method of controlling hydrogen/oxygen producing system and hydrogen/oxygen producing system
column13: A method of controlling a hydrogen/oxygen producing system is a method of controlling a hydrogen/oxygen producing system including a water electrolysis apparatus that electrolyzes liquid water by applying current to an anode and a cathode, and a hydrogen gas pressurizing part that pressurizes hydrogen at downstream of the water electrolysis apparatus by applying current to a pressurizing part anode and a pressurizing part cathode. A controller controls current applied to the water electrolysis apparatus and current applied to the hydrogen gas pressurizing part. When the hydrogen/oxygen producing system is stopped, the controller performs first decompression processing such that a decompression speed of the pressurizing part cathode of the hydrogen gas pressurizing part does not exceed a basic decompression speed and performs second decompression processing such that a decompression speed of the anode of the water electrolysis apparatus does not exceed the decompression speed of the pressurizing part cathode.

column12: Membrane electrode for water electrolysis, preparation method of membrane electrode and water electrolysis tank
column13: The invention relates to a membrane electrode for water electrolysis, a preparation method of the membrane electrode and a water electrolysis tank. The membrane electrode for water electrolysis comprises a cathode catalyst layer and an anion exchange membrane layer which are stacked, the cathode catalyst layer comprises an AEM ionomer, and the anion exchange membrane layer comprises an anion exchange membrane. The anion-exchange membrane is applied to a membrane electrode material for water electrolysis, the distance between the cathode and the anode of the electrode is shortened, and compared with an alkaline water electrolysis device in the prior art, under the same scale, a galvanic pile is small in size and light in weight. The AEM ionomer is added into the cathode catalyst layer, so that the bonding capacity of the cathode catalyst layer is improved, the possibility that the cathode catalyst layer is scoured by gas or liquid to peel off during water electrolysis is reduced, the operation stability of the electrode is improved, and the service life of the electrode is prolonged.

column12: Preparation method and application of self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. According to the method, the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode directly and vertically grown on a nickel fiber felt substrate is obtained through a simple one-step impregnation method. The electrode prepared by the method is applied to the water electrolysis oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. Wherein the obtained nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is in a nanoflower shape extending outwards from the center, the particle diameter of the nanoflower is 500 nm to 5 [mu] m, and the thickness of the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is 5 to 10 [mu] m; the thickness of the nickel fiber felt ranges from 0.25 mm to 0.4 mm. As a three-dimensional skeleton of foamed nickel easily punctures an anionic membrane, the performance and long-term operation life of alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) are influenced. Therefore, the nickel fiber felt is adopted as the substrate, and the problems can be effectively solved. In addition, the invention has wide utilization value in renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

column12: Electrolyte regeneration
column13: A system for regenerating electrolyte from an electrochemical cell, comprising; a directing means for receiving electrolyte from an electrochemical cell, the directing means having a first and a second outlet; a sensor or sample port positioned between the electrochemical cell and the first and second outlets via which contaminants in the electrolyte may be measured; and a purification stage for receiving electrolyte from the second outlet and producing regenerated electrolyte, the stage comprising an ion exchange chamber; wherein when a contaminant is detected, at least a portion of the electrolyte is directed by the directing means through the second outlet to the purification stage. A method for regenerating an electrolyte from an electrochemical cell is also defined. The system may comprise the electrochemical cell from which the electrolyte is regenerated, and this may comprise an electrolyser or stack of electrolysers wherein the system comprises means for combining the electrolyte streams into a single stream. column12: Seawater electrolysis catalyst with molybdate passivation layer as well as preparation method and application of seawater electrolysis catalyst
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a seawater electrolysis catalyst with a molybdate passivation layer, which comprises the following steps: loading a molybdenum-based material on a substrate to form a pre-catalyst; and placing the pre-catalyst as an anode in an electrolyte, and forming a molybdate passivation layer in situ on the surface of the pre-catalyst by using an anodic oxidation reaction to obtain the seawater electrolysis catalyst with the molybdate passivation layer. column12: Preparation method of Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P nanorod electrocatalyst
column13: The invention belongs to the field of nano material preparation, and discloses a nickel-molybdenum-iron compound growing on foamed nickel and a preparation method and application of an anion exchange membrane. The difunctional electrocatalyst Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P with an amorphous MoOx and crystal Ni2P/Fe2P heterogeneous structure is prepared through a hydrothermal-etching-phosphating method. Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P is used as a cathode and an anode, an overall water decomposition (OWS) performance test is carried out in an electrolyte containing 1M of KOH, and the required voltage is only 1.815 V when the current density reaches the large current density of 250mA cm < 2 >. This is attributed to sufficient active sites, abundant phase interfaces and a unique nanorod array structure in the nickel-molybdenum-iron compound. The material still has excellent stability under the ultrahigh constant current density of 500 mA cm < 2 >. The PVA/PDDA-OH <-> membrane with anion selectivity is prepared through physical crosslinking of PVA and PDDA, and the PVA/PDDA-OH <-> membrane has good OH <-> conductivity. The anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer assembled by using the Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P catalyst and PVA/PDDA-OH <-> stably operates for 250 hours under the current density of 1 A cm <-2 >, the hydrogen production Faraday efficiency is about 94.8% through calculation, and the potential of the anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer in the actual application of large-current hydrogen production is highlighted.

column12: Alkali-swelling-resistant and high OH-conduction bifunctional composite anion exchange membrane and application thereof in alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production system
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical catalysts, in particular to an anti-alkali-swelling high-OH-conduction difunctional composite anion exchange membrane and application thereof in an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production system, and the anti-alkali-swelling high-OH-conduction difunctional composite anion exchange membrane comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of quaternized polyether-ether-ketone QPEEK, 5-10 parts of hydroxyapatite HAP, 3-6 parts of quaternized graphene quantum dots Q-GQDs and a solvent N, N-dimethyl formamide. 400 parts of N, N-dimethyl acetyl DMAc; through the double-filler synergistic effect of HAP and Q-GQDs, the swelling problem of the membrane is effectively solved. HAP is used as an inorganic rigid filler, and forms a strong interface bonding force with a QPEEK matrix after being subjected to special pretreatment, so that the relaxation movement of a QPEEK molecular chain in alkali liquor is limited, and the deformation of a membrane structure is inhibited; the Q-GQDs can be uniformly fused into a matrix due to the nanoscale size, so that the interface defect caused by filler agglomeration is avoided, and the anti-swelling stability of the membrane is not influenced. Compared with a pure QPEEK film, the composite film disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the long-term swelling rate in a strong-alkalinity and high-temperature environment is greatly reduced, and the long-term stability of the film structure is ensured.

column12: Preparation method of bipolar membrane for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bipolar membrane for hydrogen production through electrolysis of water, and relates to the field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water. column12: Preparation method and application of membrane electrode based on anode catalyst coating film
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a membrane electrode based on an anode catalyst coating film, and belongs to the technical field of membrane electrode preparation and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dispersing an anode catalyst, a binder and an ionomer into a solvent, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to prepare a catalyst dispersion liquid; (2) adsorbing the anion exchange membrane on a heating plate, and heating the heating plate to a set temperature; spraying the catalyst dispersion liquid on an anion exchange membrane to obtain an anion exchange membrane for adsorbing an anode catalyst; (3) clamping the anion exchange membrane for adsorbing the anode catalyst between two pieces of Teflon cloth, and placing the Teflon cloth between two graphite plates for hot pressing to obtain an anode catalyst coated membrane electrode; according to the preparation method and application of the membrane electrode based on the anode catalyst coating membrane, the problem of substrate interface separation in the traditional catalyst coating substrate technology is effectively solved, so that the ohmic impedance is reduced, and the mass transfer efficiency is improved.

column12: Cobalt manganese oxide catalyst-nonporous anion exchange membrane composite system stable in high-temperature alkaline environment
column13: The invention relates to the related field of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a cobalt manganese oxide catalyst-nonporous anion exchange membrane composite system stable in high-temperature alkaline environment, which comprises a cobalt manganese oxide nanosheet and a quaternized polyarylene ether nitrile nonporous membrane, the metal molar ratio of Co to Mn of the cobalt manganese oxide is 1: 1-3: 1, and the metal molar ratio of the cobalt manganese oxide nanosheet to the quaternized polyarylene ether nitrile nonporous membrane is 1: 1-3: 1. After acid etching, the oxygen vacancy concentration is 0.2-0.5 mmol/g, and the specific surface area is 120-180m < 2 >/g; the quaternization degree of the non-porous membrane is 70-90%, the conductivity at 80 DEG C is greater than or equal to 100mS/cm, and the swelling rate in 10MKOH is 1t; 5%. According to oxygen vacancies (0.2-0.5 mmol/g) and high specific surface area (120-180 m < 2 >/g) formed after cobalt manganese oxide in the composite system is subjected to acid etching, the number of catalytic active sites is remarkably increased, an electronic structure (for example, the ratio of Co < 3 + > is increased) is optimized, the OER overpotential is as low as 210-230 mV under 10 mA/cm < 2 >, the Tafel slope is smaller than or equal to 38 mV/dec, and the charge transfer resistance is smaller than or equal to 20 omega, which are far superior to those of an unetched catalyst and a traditional system; and the water electrolysis oxygen evolution reaction rate is accelerated.

column12: High-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell as well as preparation method and application of high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, in particular to a high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method and application of the high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The problems that in an existing anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the OER overpotential is high, a catalyst layer is prone to falling off under the ampere-level current density, the preparation method is complex, and large-scale preparation is difficult are solved. The method comprises the following steps: 1) adding ferric nitrate into isopropanol, and violently stirring and dissolving to obtain a solution A; thiourea is added into deionized water to be dissolved, and a solution B is obtained; adding the solution B into the solution A under violent stirring to obtain a uniform solution C; and 2) putting the metal porous material substrate subjected to ultrasonic cleaning with ethanol and a hydrochloric acid solution into the solution C for dipping, then taking out the metal porous material substrate, washing the metal porous material substrate with a large amount of deionized water, and drying the metal porous material substrate to obtain the integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The prepared oxygen evolution catalyst not only has high oxygen evolution catalytic activity, but also is tightly combined with a substrate, and long-term stable operation with ampere-level current density can be realized.

column12: Alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic bath for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water and preparation method of alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic bath
column13: The invention provides an alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic cell for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water and a preparation method of the alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic cell. column12: PRODUCTION OF ELECTROCATALYTICALLY ACTIVE LAYERED BODIES WITH ANION CONDUCTIVITY
column13: The invention relates, inter alia, to an electrocatalytically active layered body, to the production thereof and to the use thereof as an anion exchange membrane in alkaline water electrolysis. The problem addressed was that of producing a catalytically active anion exchange membrane on an industrial scale without distortion. Said anion exchange membrane is intended to be stable under alkaline conditions, to have good conductivity for hydroxide ions and to make it possible to carry out alkaline membrane water electrolysis with high efficiency. Production is intended to be carried out without the use of fluoropolymers, and as far as possible CMR substances should not be used. In the method described here, a layer of an ionomer which has a conductivity for OH− is applied to a catalytically active substrate. The ionomer layer forms the later membrane and the substrate forms the catalyst layer. An essential aspect of the method is that the catalytically active substrate, which is coated with the ionomer, is provided with dissolvable structure-forming agents. These substances can be leached or washed out of the catalyst layer, thereby leaving pores. The invention also relates to a not yet leached-out or washed-out precursor of the layered body.

The problem addressed was that of producing a catalytically active anion exchange membrane on an industrial scale without distortion. Said anion exchange membrane is intended to be stable under alkaline conditions, to have good conductivity for hydroxide ions and to make it possible to carry out alkaline membrane water electrolysis with high efficiency. Production is intended to be carried out without the use of fluoropolymers, and as far as possible CMR substances should not be used. In the method described here, a layer of an ionomer which has a conductivity for OH− is applied to a catalytically active substrate. The ionomer layer forms the later membrane and the substrate forms the catalyst layer. An essential aspect of the method is that the catalytically active substrate, which is coated with the ionomer, is provided with dissolvable structure-forming agents. These substances can be leached or washed out of the catalyst layer, thereby leaving pores. The invention also relates to a not yet leached-out or washed-out precursor of the layered body.

column12: Self-repairing type oxygen evolution catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of electro-catalysis water decomposition, in particular to a self-repairing type oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method, the NiCoFe-based (NiCoFe-Bi) oxygen evolution catalyst containing the borate radical intercalation layer is prepared by adopting a simple electro-deposition method. When being applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) tank for electrocatalytic water decomposition, the NiCoFe-Bi catalyst is efficient and stable through the leaching-redeposition self-repairing process of a Fe catalytic active center in cooperation with use of a KOH self-repairing electrolyte containing Fe < 2 + > ions and borate ions. The OER catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of low cost, high activity and ultra-long-term stability, the preparation method is simple, and powerful support is provided for the development of electro-catalytic water decomposition.

column12: Water electrolysis hydrogen production system
column13: The invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production system. According to the water electrolysis hydrogen production system, in the circulating movement process of the conductor flexible belt, the multiple auxiliary electrodes are driven by the conductor flexible belt to sequentially enter the electrolyte in the hydrogen evolution container and the electrolyte in the oxygen evolution container, and therefore hydrogen and oxygen are generated in the separated hydrogen evolution container and the oxygen evolution container in the mode that the hydrogen evolution container and the oxygen evolution container are separated from each other but not mixed; the hydrogen with very high purity can be obtained without post-treatment, so that the hydrogen is convenient to collect, transport and store. Besides, a proton exchange membrane and an anion exchange membrane can be omitted in the water electrolysis hydrogen production system, so that the membrane-free water electrolysis hydrogen production system is formed, and the cost of the water electrolysis hydrogen production system is reduced. Moreover, in the system for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water, the system can continuously work to produce hydrogen under the conditions of no loss of active substances, sufficient electrolyte supplementation and continuous electrification, so that the requirement of large-scale industrial production is ensured.

column12: Self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production. The electrode is obtained by combining a hydrothermal method and an electro-deposition method; according to the electrode, a manganese-doped basic cobalt carbonate nanowire vertically grows on the surface of foamed nickel, and the periphery of the nanowire is wrapped with a plurality of lamellar nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets to form a whole nanorod. The nanorods are uniform in size, the length of the nanorods is 2-3 microns, the diameter of the nanorods is 100-500 nm, and the nanorods vertically grow on the surface of the foamed nickel; the electrode has relatively high catalytic activity and stability, and after foamed nickel is used as a conductive substrate, the electrode can still stably run for a long time in a strong alkaline medium under relatively high electrolytic current; the electrode is applied to water electrolysis hydrogen production and oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

column12: Rapid preparation method and application of NiFe-LDH nickel-based electrode
column13: The invention discloses a rapid preparation method and application of a NiFe-LDH nickel-based electrode, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, the preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, at normal temperature and normal pressure, immersing a cleaned nickel-based substrate material in a ferric iron (Fe < 3 + >) etching solution for chemical etching, standing for a proper time for full reaction, and taking out the nickel-based substrate material; taking out and drying; s2, immersing the material obtained in the step S1 into a strong alkaline solution for soaking treatment, standing for a proper time to enable the material to fully react, and then taking out and drying; and S3, assembling the electrode material prepared in the step S2 into a membrane electrode, and loading the membrane electrode into an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water tank single battery for testing, so that the electric energy can be stably converted into hydrogen energy when the anion exchange membrane electrolysis water tank single battery works. According to the technical scheme, the electrolyzed water anode electrode can be rapidly prepared in a low-cost, environment-friendly and large-batch mode, the defect that an electrode preparation method in the same field at present is tedious is overcome, and commercialized development of the alkaline membrane electrolyzed water hydrogen production technology is expected to be promoted.

column12: HIGHLY ALKALI-STABLE POLY(ARYLENE ALKYLENE PIPERIDINIUM) CATIONIC POLYMERS AND PREPARATION METHODS AND APPLICATIONS
column13: The present invention relates to the field of cationic polymers, and in particular, to highly alkali-stable poly(arylene alkylene piperidinium) cationic polymers and preparation methods and applications. The preparation method for the highly alkali-stable poly(arylene alkylene piperidinium) cationic polymers includes the following steps: performing catalytic polycondensation on 1-R6-piperidine-3-carboxaldehyde or a salt or hydrate thereof and an aromatic compound to obtain a polymer having a piperidine moiety; and then further subjecting the polymer to a quaternization reaction to obtain the poly(arylene alkylene piperidinium) cationic polymer. The anion exchange membranes prepared from the piperidinium-based cationic polymers have ultra-high alkaline stability and excellent mechanical properties and ionic conductivities, and can be applied to the fields of electrochemical energy conversion such as fuel cells, hydrogen production by water electrolysis, electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide, flow batteries, and fields of separation such as electrodialysis and water treatment.

column12: BOP SEPARATE TYPE BOP APPLIED WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE
column13: A detachable BOP-applied water electrolysis device is provided. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the detachable BOP-applied water electrolysis device comprises: a water electrolysis tank which includes a cathode chamber and an anode chamber in which oxygen and hydrogen are respectively generated by electrolysis, and an anion exchange membrane which is between the cathode chamber and the anode chamber to allow anions to be exchanged; a cathode gas-liquid separator and an anode gas-liquid separator which each separate the oxygen or hydrogen generated in the cathode chamber and the anode chamber from the electrolyte; a pair of pressure gauges which measure the pressures of oxygen and hydrogen discharged from the cathode gas-liquid separator and the anode gas-liquid separator; a pressure control unit which detects the pressure difference between the pair of pressure gauges and controls the pressure difference to be kept at a constant level; and an inclined liquid pipe which is installed in an inclined form between the cathode gas-liquid separator and the anode gas-liquid separator. According to the present invention, it is possible to prevent hydrogen and oxygen remaining in an electrolyte from mixing, and thus, ignition during an electrolysis process can be prevented.

column12: Catalyst-coated polymer electrolyte membranes and methods for their manufacture
column13: A method for the manufacture of catalyst-coated polymer electrolyte membranes (CCMs) for water electrolysis is described. The CCMs may comprise a proton exchange membrane (PEM) or an anion exchange membrane (AEM) with an anode layer and/or a cathode catalyst layer applied to a face of the membrane. The method comprises the steps of forming a polymer electrolyte membrane on a first catalyst layer 2 comprising a platinum-containing catalyst on a carbon support material 1 and a catalyst layer ion-conducting polymer. The catalytic layer 2 may comprise a hydrogen evolution catalyst (HER) and/or an oxygen evolution catalyst (OER). The first catalyst layer 2 has an expected effective platinum surface area in the range of and including 5-200 cm2Pt/cm2 and a carbon content in the range of and including 30-60 wt%.

column12: Alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production device, electrolytic bath thereof and membrane electrode assembly of electrolytic bath
column13: The embodiment of the invention provides an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device, an electrolytic bath thereof and a membrane electrode assembly of the electrolytic bath. The electrolytic bath comprises an anode end plate, an anode current collector, a membrane assembly, a cathode current collector and a cathode end plate. A water inlet is formed in the anode end plate and is used for injecting an electrolyte stock solution from one side of the anode side of the electrolytic cell. The membrane electrode assembly comprises an anode diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode diffusion layer, the exchange membrane comprises a first thin film and a second thin film which are in contact, the first thin film is an alkaline ionic membrane, and the second thin film is an ion solvation membrane or an anion exchange membrane. In operation, anode liquid supply and a differential pressure type scheme can be adopted for hydrogen production, and the problems that in an alkaline water electrolysis device adopting a traditional electrode, membrane puncture is caused during pressure operation, and hydrogen in oxygen exceeds the standard can be avoided.

column12: Dp track coupling type MXene loaded phosphide heterojunction electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of an MMoP-CoP/Ti3C2 heterojunction electrocatalyst based on dp track coupling and application of the MMoP-CoP/Ti3C2 heterojunction electrocatalyst in alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen evolution (HER) and full water splitting, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic materials and new energy. According to the invention, polyoxometallate (POMs) is encapsulated in a cobalt-based imidazolate framework (ZIFL) and anchored on Ti3C2 MXene, and a strong coupling MMoP (at) CoP/Ti3C2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni, Cu) heterojunction is constructed in situ through low-temperature phosphorization. The heterojunction interface work function difference (delta phi) is accurately regulated and controlled to 0.06 eV through the 3d orbit of the transition metal M and the 3p orbit of the transition metal P, the interface hydrogen overflow potential barrier is remarkably reduced, and efficient alkaline hydrogen evolution and stable anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) are achieved. The overpotential of the obtained FeMoP-coated CoP/Ti3C2 is only 58.9 mV when the voltage is 10 Accm <-2 >, the Tafel slope is 47.85 mV dec-1, a symmetric AEM electrolytic tank can realize 1 Accm <-2 > at 1.96 V and stably operate for 1000 hours, and the method is superior to commercial Pt/C//RuO2. The process is mild, the structure is controllable, the cost is low, and a general preparation strategy is provided for the non-noble metal efficient electrolyzed water catalyst.

column12: Crosslinking of hydroxide stable, polybenzimidazoliums and polyimidazoliums membranes and ionomers
column13: Described herein are crosslinked alkylated poly(benzimidazole) and poly(imidazole) polymer materials and devices (e.g., fuel cells, water electrolyzers) including these polymer materials. The polymer materials can be prepared in a convenient manner, allowing for applications such as anion exchange membranes (AEMs). The membranes provide high anion conductivities over a wider range of operating conditions when compared to the analogous membranes that are not cross-linked. The crosslinked polymer materials have improved alkaline stability, when compared to the analogous non-crosslinked polymer materials.

column12: PEEK fiber for water electrolysis hydrogen production diaphragm, diaphragm base cloth and application
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of diaphragm materials for water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a PEEK fiber for a diaphragm for water electrolysis hydrogen production, diaphragm base cloth and application. column12: A reliable electrolyser system
column13: Disclosed is a stable electrolysis system. The stable water electrolysis system for producing hydrogen through a water electrolysis reaction according to the present invention includes: a water electrolysis stack for producing hydrogen and oxygen, a check valve in the hydrogen discharge line, a liquid pump composed of a pressurizer, an adsorber and an oxygen discharge line, a three-way valve, an air-cooled heat exchanger, a liquid return tank, an oxygen water separator and a quantitative water pump that supplies a quantitative amount of water consumed during hydrogen production, a power supply that supplies electricity to the auxiliary water tank and the electrolysis stack, a bleed resistance part and a control device, wherein water is supplied in real-time at regular quantities upon producing hydrogen to keep the water electrolysis stack temperature constant, thereby stabilizing the hydrogen production reaction, and a constant concentration of an alkaline electrolyte solution such as anion exchange membrane water electrolysis is maintained, thereby providing constant hydrogen production. In addition, after the discharge step of discharging oxygen from the electrode of the unit cell of the water electrolysis stack, the residual voltage of the water electrolysis stack generated when the water electrolysis system is stopped, a residual voltage is removed by using the bleed resistance, so that an abnormal behavior of the electrolytic stack is prevented.

column12: AEM electrolyzed water membrane electrode and preparation method thereof

The AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode comprises a cathode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a hydrogen elimination layer I and an anode catalyst layer which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, optionally, a hydrogen elimination layer II is also arranged between the cathode catalyst layer and the anion exchange membrane; the hydrogen elimination layer I comprises a first hydrogen elimination layer and a second hydrogen elimination layer, and a hydrogen elimination catalyst in the first hydrogen elimination layer is selected from at least one of platinum, palladium and iridium; a hydrogen elimination catalyst in the second hydrogen elimination layer is selected from at least one of cerium oxide, copper oxide, aluminum oxide, zirconium oxide, niobium oxide, tantalum oxide, tungsten oxide, yttrium oxide, strontium oxide and vanadium oxide. According to the AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode, the usage amount of a noble metal catalyst in the first hydrogen elimination layer is reduced, the problem that the noble metal is exposed to high potential to cause oxidation corrosion and lose the hydrogen elimination effect is solved, and the AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode has a wide application prospect in the field of AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and hydrogen elimination.

column12: Active foamed nickel anode and activation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an active foamed nickel anode and an activation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. The activation method comprises the following steps: carrying out a reaction on pretreated foamed nickel and a solid phosphorus-containing precursor in a non-direct contact manner, introducing inert gas, exhausting air, carrying out programmed heating calcination activation, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the active foamed nickel anode. The method is simple in process, remarkable in effect and suitable for large-scale production, the specific surface area of the catalyst can be greatly increased, the water electrolysis oxygen evolution (OER) performance of the foamed nickel is enhanced, and the method can be directly applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis in an alkaline or anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

column13: A decoupling hydrogen production device comprises an electrolytic tank used for electrolysis and further comprises a solar panel, a first infusion tube, a cathode plate and an anode plate, the electrolytic tank is connected with the solar panel used for power supply through a wire, one side of the electrolytic tank is connected with the first infusion tube, one end of the first infusion tube is connected with a first infusion pump, and the other end of the first infusion tube is connected with a second infusion pump. column12: Main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving a linear structure phenyl monomer, a strong bond energy linear structure phenyl monomer, 1, 2-diphenylethane and N-methyl-4-piperidone to obtain a precursor polymer solution; dropwise adding trifluoroacetic acid and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid to obtain a main chain type polyarene piperidine polymer precursor; and dissolving the polyaromatic piperidine, adding methyl iodide and potassium carbonate, reacting to obtain a quaternized main chain type polyaromatic piperidine polymer, and carrying out membrane treatment and alkali treatment processes to obtain the anion exchange membrane. By introducing the high-rigidity hydrophobic linear monomer with strong bond energy, the problem of mutual entanglement between linear main chains of a traditional polymer is solved, larger free volume and steric hindrance are provided, and high ionic conductivity and high alkali stability of the anion exchange membrane are realized; therefore, the water electrolysis performance of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank is further improved, and high-performance and high-stability electrolytic tank application is realized.

column12: Resource recycling method and application of spinel type positive electrode material of waste secondary battery
column13: The invention discloses a resource recycling method for a spinel type positive electrode material of a waste secondary battery and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank. The recycling method comprises the following steps: respectively pretreating a positive electrode material carrier and a negative electrode foil material; dissolving a first metal salt in a first solvent to obtain a metal salt ion electrolyte; dissolving a second metal salt in a second solvent to obtain a metal salt ion solution, adding the pretreated positive electrode material carrier, infiltrating to obtain a positive electrode precursor material, and carrying out heat treatment to obtain a positive electrode material; assembling the negative electrode foil material, the positive electrode material and the metal salt ion electrolyte into a secondary battery, and carrying out electrochemical reaction; disassembling the secondary battery to obtain an electrochemically treated positive electrode material, and carrying out high-temperature cleaning and drying on the obtained positive electrode material by using a third solvent; and stripping the positive electrode material from the carrier to separate the positive electrode material carrier to obtain a positive electrode spinel oxide material and drying. According to the invention, the positive electrode material of the secondary battery can be recycled and used for a new anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank.

column12: Composite anionic membrane for hydrogen production of AEM electrolytic cell and preparation method of composite anionic membrane
column13: The invention discloses a composite anionic membrane for hydrogen production of an AEM electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the composite anionic membrane, and relates to a water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane material technology in the field of hydrogen energy. column12: Preparation method and application of seawater electrolysis catalyst based on strain engineering
column13: The invention belongs to the field of strain engineering materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a Mo-doped Fe2O3 HER electrocatalyst and application of the Mo-doped Fe2O3 HER electrocatalyst in large-current seawater electrolysis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: growing Fe2O3 on a self-supporting material through molten salt, soaking (NH4) 6Mo7O24. 4H2O, and calcining to obtain the final Mo-doped Fe2O3 electrocatalyst (2%-Mo-Fe2O3). Under the condition that an anion exchange membrane electrolyzes seawater (electrolyte: 1M KOH seawater, and temperature: 60 DEG C), the current density of 1A/cm < 2 > can be reached only by a working voltage of 2V, and stable operation can be performed for 100 hours under the condition of industrial seawater. Compared with a traditional method for preparing a bifunctional electrocatalyst, the method has the advantages that the problem of slow dynamics in the process of electrolyzing alkaline seawater is solved by utilizing strain engineering, and the catalytic stability can be kept under the condition of high current density while efficient catalysis is ensured; the work provides a strategy for applying strain engineering to preparation of a catalyst for seawater hydrogen production.

column13: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic advanced nano materials, and discloses a method for synthesizing an electrolytic seawater corrosion-resistant anode at room temperature in a macroscopic quantity. column12: Water electrolysis system and control method thereof
column13: The present invention discloses a water electrolysis system for increasing the purity of hydrogen generated in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack. According to the present invention, a water electrolysis system comprises: a hydrogen separator for separating hydrogen produced in a water electrolysis stack; a reactor for removing oxygen contained in the hydrogen transferred from the hydrogen separator; a pre-treatment dehumidifier for primary dehumidification of moisture contained in the hydrogen transferred from the reactor; a heat exchanger for cooling the hydrogen that has passed through the pre-treatment dehumidifier; a gas-water separator for separating water from the hydrogen that has passed through the heat exchanger; a dryer for secondary drying of the hydrogen that has passed through the gas-water separator; and a control unit for controlling valves installed in pipelines connecting the reactor, the pre-treatment dehumidifier, the heat exchanger, the gas-water separator, and the dryer, wherein the control unit controls a control valve to bypass the pre-treatment dehumidifier when a moisture value contained in the hydrogen that has passed through the gas-water separator is equal to or less than a set value, and to pass the hydrogen through the pre-treatment dehumidifier to remove moisture before transferring it to the dryer when the moisture value contained in the hydrogen that has passed through the gas-water separator is equal to or greater than the set value.

column12: Ion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and water electrolysis hydrogen production device
column13: The invention relates to an ion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and a water electrolysis hydrogen production device, and aims to solve the technical problem that the stability of an anion exchange group of a related anion exchange membrane is relatively low. The ion exchange membrane and the preparation method thereof provided by the invention comprise the following steps: dissolving meta-PBI in a solvent to obtain a first mixed solution; adding methyl iodide into the first mixed solution to react and generate a precipitate; carrying out purification treatment on the precipitate, so as to obtain Meta-PBI subjected to iodomethanation; dissolving the mixed solution in a dimethyl sulfoxide solution, and adding dibromo-p-xylene to obtain a second mixed solution; and carrying out evaporation treatment on the second mixed solution under a vacuum condition to obtain the ion exchange membrane. The ion exchange membrane containing the 2-phenylbenzimidazole system is prepared, and 2-phenylbenzimidazole ions are used as anion exchange groups with stable resonance, so that the ion exchange membrane can stably exist in a water electrolysis hydrogen production system.

column12: High-entropy alloy electrolytic water catalytic hydrogen evolution material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a high-entropy alloy water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalytic material and a preparation method thereof. The catalytic material comprises a conductive substrate material and a high-entropy alloy film deposited on the surface of the conductive substrate material, the chemical formula of the high-entropy alloy film is (FeCoNiCr) 100-xPtx based on the mole percentage of each atom, and x is greater than or equal to 10 and less than or equal to 40. The preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing raw materials of iron, cobalt, nickel, chromium and platinum according to the mole percentage content of each atom, and preparing a master alloy ingot by using a vacuum arc melting method; taking the master alloy ingot as a target material, depositing on a substrate through a pulse laser deposition method to obtain a high-entropy alloy film, and then performing electrochemical treatment to obtain the high-entropy alloy film. The material is low in cost, high in efficiency, high in stability and high in controllability, the high-entropy alloy film electrolytic water hydrogen evolution catalytic material which is excellent in catalytic efficiency and high in applicability is obtained by optimizing the deposition process and reasonably controlling electrochemical treatment conditions, and the high-entropy alloy film electrolytic water hydrogen evolution catalytic material is good in operation stability in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

column12: Method and device for desulfurizing and producing hydrogen by electrolyzing hydrogen sulfide under photovoltaic driving
column13: The invention provides a method and a device for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing hydrogen sulfide through photovoltaic driving, and belongs to the fields of low-carbon green acid gas purification technology, environmental protection and renewable energy sources. The system provides electric energy through renewable energy sources, H2S gas enters an electrolytic bath after entering an alkali liquor bottle to be absorbed, the electrolytic bath electrolyzes a sulfur-containing alkaline aqueous solution to obtain hydrogen and polysulfide, and the hydrogen and the polysulfide are acidified and purified through a sulfur recovery tank and a sulfur refining tank. Hydroxyl radicals are generated while hydrogen is generated at the cathode through the AEM electrolytic cell, the hydroxyl radicals are migrated to the anode chamber through the anion exchange membrane and enter the alkali liquor bottle under circulation of the pump for hydrogen sulfide absorption, and the problems that hydrogen sulfide is continuously absorbed by continuously adding alkali liquor, and secondary separation of products is needed are solved; the invention also provides an AEM hydrogen sulfide electrolysis desulfurization hydrogen production device.

column12: Ordered array membrane electrode and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a preparation method and application of an ordered array membrane electrode. The ordered array membrane electrode comprises a membrane and a catalyst layer, at least one side of the film is provided with grooves arranged in an array mode, and the catalyst layer covers the at least one side, provided with the grooves, of the film and fills the grooves; the catalyst layer comprises a catalyst and an ionomer; the degree of swelling of the membrane is less than the degree of swelling of the ionomer in the catalyst layer. According to the obtained ordered array membrane electrode, the interface interlocking effect is caused by the swelling degree difference of the membrane-ionomer, the interface bonding strength of the membrane electrode is enhanced, the surface area of the catalyst layer is increased, water transmission in the membrane electrode is enhanced, and the pure water electrolysis performance and durability of the anion exchange membrane are improved.

column12: Multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system and electrolytic hydrogen production method
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy, and discloses a multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system and an electrolytic hydrogen production method.The multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system comprises a first-stage electrolytic tank electric pile and a second-stage electrolytic tank electric pile; the primary electrolytic tank electric pile is any one of a high-temperature proton conductor electrolytic tank electric pile, a low-temperature proton exchange membrane electrolytic tank electric pile, a low-temperature alkaline electrolytic tank electric pile and a low-temperature anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank electric pile; the secondary electrolytic tank electric pile is a high-temperature oxygen ion conductor electrolytic electric pile; the cathode side of the first-stage electrolytic cell stack is communicated with the cathode side of the second-stage electrolytic cell stack in series, and hydrogen generated by electrochemical reaction of the first-stage electrolytic cell stack can be conveyed to the cathode side of the second-stage electrolytic cell stack. According to the multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system, the working efficiency and durability of the high-temperature oxygen ion conductor electrolytic galvanic pile are improved, the service life of the high-temperature oxygen ion conductor electrolytic galvanic pile is prolonged, the complexity and production cost of the multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system are reduced, power consumption caused by a circulating pump is avoided, and the hydrogen production efficiency is improved.

column12: Preparation method and application of branched polyaryl piperidine membrane containing multiple aromatic ring units
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a branched polyaryl piperidine membrane containing multiple aromatic ring units, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells and water electrolysis hydrogen production anion exchange membranes. According to the invention, a branched polyarylpiperidine main chain is constructed by introducing a multi-aromatic ring branched unit with multiple reaction sites into a conventional linear polyarylpiperidine main chain, so that the bulk density of the main chain is reduced, formation of ion clusters is facilitated, and the conductivity of the membrane is improved. And the branching degree can be regulated and controlled by flexibly adjusting the feeding of the multi-aromatic-ring branched monomer. The conductivity of the branched polyaryl piperidine membrane is increased by more than 26% compared with that of a linear membrane, and the branched membrane has a lower swelling ratio and higher hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell power density and water electrolysis hydrogen production performance.

column12: Preparation method and application of self-supporting B-doped NiFe LDHs oxygen evolution electrode
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a self-supporting B-doped NiFe LDHs oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water. According to the electrode, foamed nickel serves as a substrate, the substrate is loaded with B-doped NiFe LDHs serving as a catalytic active component, the morphology of the B-doped NiFe LDHs is that a plurality of porous nanometer flower ball structures which are formed by arranging and stacking nanosheets in a staggered mode grow on the foamed nickel substrate, and the diameter of each nanometer flower ball is 500 nm to 2 microns. According to the preparation method, the B-doped NiFe LDHs OER electrode directly and vertically grown on the foamed nickel substrate is obtained through a simple one-step impregnation method, the morphology of a synthetic catalyst can be effectively controlled under a mild condition, and the B-doped NiFe LDHs OER electrode has good catalytic activity and stability. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, seawater electrolysis and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

column12: Method for preparing AEM water electrolysis anode and application
column13: The invention provides a method for preparing an AEM water electrolysis anode and application of the AEM water electrolysis anode. The method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a ruthenium chloride trihydrate solution with a solvent, and shearing to obtain a dispersion solution; and (2) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the dispersion solution obtained in the step (1) and foamed nickel, carrying out primary drying to obtain a precursor material, then coating the surface of the precursor material with an anion exchange membrane ionomer, and carrying out secondary drying to obtain the AEM water electrolysis anode. By loading the ruthenium dioxide catalyst on the positive electrode of the foamed nickel electrode in situ, the AEM water electrolysis positive electrode can be directly prepared, the preparation method is simple, and the material utilization rate is high.

column12: Nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps that the surface of a foamed nickel sheet is cleaned and dried, and a clean oil-free foamed nickel sheet is obtained; dissolving nickel nitrate, ferric nitrate and ammonium heptamolybdate in deionized water to obtain dispersion liquid; transferring the dispersion liquid into a hydrothermal kettle, putting a foamed nickel sheet into the hydrothermal kettle, carrying out hydrothermal treatment in a drying oven, naturally cooling, washing and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with nickel molybdate and iron molybdate catalysts; and preparing an ionomer solution, spraying the ionomer solution onto the electrode precursor, and drying to obtain the oxygen evolution catalytic electrode. The invention provides a preparation scheme of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution catalytic electrode which is simple in preparation method, low in synthesis cost, non-toxic and harmless, and the catalyst in the electrode has a microstructure different from that of a common molybdate catalyst and has high electrochemical catalytic activity. The electrolytic bath based on the catalytic electrode can efficiently electrolyze dilute alkali liquor to produce hydrogen, and the energy consumption and the safety of the electrolytic bath are superior to those of a traditional alkaline water electrolysis system.

column12: Anion exchange membrane AEM electrolytic bath with asymmetric structure
column13: The invention provides an anionic membrane AEM electrolytic bath with an asymmetric structure, and belongs to the field of structural design of alkaline membrane electrolytic baths. The anode side of the electrolytic cell adopts a rigid net as a gas diffusion layer, and the cathode side adopts an elastic net as a gas diffusion layer. According to the electrolytic cell, the asymmetric rigid net and the elastic net are adopted as gas diffusion layers, and a groove flow channel structure is omitted, so that on one hand, the porosity in the electrolytic cell can be increased, a larger flow channel area is provided, the gas-liquid two-phase fluid mass transfer resistance is reduced while the contact area of an electrode of the electrolytic cell and liquid is increased, and bubble discharge is facilitated; the processing and assembling difficulty is reduced; on the other hand, due to the existence of the cathode side elastic net, the assembly reliability can be improved, the sealing problem is solved, the membrane electrode and the bipolar plate are in full contact, the hydrogen bubble generation position is uniform, and the contact resistance is reduced; finally, the rigid net on the anode side can serve as a supporting part and provide larger porosity, and mass transfer resistance is further reduced.

column12: Long-range disordered localized CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalyst material preparation, and discloses a long-range disordered localized CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, fluorine-doped cobalt selenide nanobelts prepared by a low-temperature annealing method are used as a base material, and the CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst is prepared by in-situ reconstruction under an alkaline electrolyzed water anode oxygen evolution reaction condition. In the preparation process of the CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet provided by the invention, lattice cobalt is stabilized in the water electrolysis anode reconstruction process through fluorine ions with strong bonding action with cobalt ions, so that the long-range disordered structure of amorphous CoOOH generated after reconstruction is limited by localization, and the alkaline water electrolysis anode reaction performance is improved. The catalyst has activity and durability obviously superior to those of a commercial ruthenium oxide catalyst in industrial application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: Oxygen vacancy mediated Ru/Ni (OH) 2-x based on hydrogen overflow and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of seawater electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses an oxygen vacancy mediated Ru/Ni (OH) 2-x based on hydrogen overflow and a preparation method and application thereof. And carrying out anhydrous RuCl3 modification treatment on the Ni/(OH) 2-x with the nanosheet morphology to obtain the hydrogen reduction electrocatalyst (Ru/Ni (OH) 2-x) with defects and noble metal/Ni-based catalyst heterojunction. Wherein the Ru phase is introduced, so that the electronic structure between the two phases can be adjusted, and more oxygen vacancies can be easily generated in the Ni (OH) 2-x phase. Oxygen vacancies generated through H2O2 heterostructure induction further promote electron transfer between Ru and Ni (OH) 2-x, the adsorption behavior of an element reaction intermediate in HER on the catalyst is improved, the hydrogen overflow effect is successfully achieved, and the intrinsic HER activity of the catalyst is improved. When being used as an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell can stably electrolyze seawater for hydrogen production for a long time, and has important value in future practical application.

column13: The invention relates to a catalyst ink, to a method for coating substrates with said ink, to the coated substrates obtained using the method, and to the use thereof. It addresses the problem of providing a catalyst ink which has a high solids content and at the same time can still be easily used with a doctor blade. As far as possible, the catalyst ink should not contain any solvents which are known to be carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic to reproduction. The coated substrates produced using the catalyst ink should be usable, in particular, in alkaline membrane water electrolysis as a catalytically active or activatable anion exchange membrane. column12: ELECTROLYSIS SYSTEM
column13: The present invention relates to an electrolysis system comprising: an electrolysis stack in which a plurality of electrolysis cells having a cathode electrode and an anode electrode are stacked on both sides of an anion exchange membrane; and an alkaline solution supply device for supplying an alkaline solution to the anode electrode, and generating hydrogen from the cathode electrode by supplying current to the cathode electrode and the anode electrode. column12: Nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) taking foamed nickel as a substrate, cleaning and airing; 2) adding deionized water into nickel salt and molybdate until the volume is 1 L, performing ultrasonic treatment, stirring, and adjusting the pH value to obtain a precursor solution; (3) soaking the substrate obtained in the step (1) into the precursor solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction; naturally cooling, washing and drying; a precursor material is obtained; and 4) heating the precursor material to 400-600 DEG C in a reducing atmosphere, and keeping the temperature for 2-3 hours to obtain the nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient. The catalyst provided by the invention shows ultralow overpotential and excellent dynamics in an alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction, and realizes industrial-grade current density and long-term stability in an alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolyser.

column12: Preparation method and application of Pt-N-C catalyst with N atomic ratio of pyridine to pyrrole being 1/1
column13: The invention aims at providing a preparation method and application of a Pt-N-C catalyst with the N atomic ratio of pyridine to pyrrole being 1/1, and belongs to the technical field of electro-catalytic materials and alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production. ZIF-8 and ZIF-67 serve as precursors, the proportion of Zn/Co is adjusted, then pyrolysis is conducted at the temperature of 920 DEG C in the H2/Ar atmosphere, the reaction that H2 and C are hydrogenated into methane at the high temperature is utilized, and the Pt-N-C catalyst with the N atomic ratio of pyridine to pyrrole being 1/1 is obtained. According to the method, pyrrole N (N5) and pyridine N (N6) are used as raw materials, carbon ring reconstruction is catalyzed by means of Co nanoparticles (Con) generated in situ, the proportion of pyrrole N (N5) to pyridine N (N6) is close to 1: 1, Pt single atoms are anchored through N coordination, and the Con-Pt1 (at) N [5]/[6] C catalyst is prepared. The catalyst has high activity and high stability, the overpotential is as low as 17 mV and is superior to that of commercial Pt/C, and the catalyst can stably run for 400 hours under the conditions of 70 DEG C and 1A/cm in an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE).

column12: Cationic COF-doped AEM electrode and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a cationic COF-doped AEM electrode and a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method comprises the steps that a covalent organic framework material (COF) which is small in particle size, good in alkali stability and rich in cationic groups is adopted as filler and is blended with a cathode catalyst and an ionomer through ultrasonic dispersion, and cathode catalyst slurry is prepared; and preparing the anion exchange membrane electrode with uniform COF dispersion and excellent performance by adopting a catalyst coating membrane technology or a catalyst coating substrate technology, and applying the anion exchange membrane electrode to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. A regular one-dimensional pore channel of the cationic covalent organic framework can provide a rapid transmission channel for gas-liquid transmission, and abundant cationic groups are beneficial to formation of a high-efficiency hydroxyl ion conduction channel, so that the mass transfer efficiency of gas, liquid and ions is remarkably improved, a three-phase reaction interface of a catalyst, gas and water is optimized, and the catalytic activity of the catalyst is improved. Therefore, the overall electrolytic hydrogen production performance is improved.
