column12: ELECTROLYTIC HYDROGEN PRODUCTION SYSTEM COUPLED WITH CAPTURING CARBON DIOXIDE FROM FLUE GAS
column13: An electrolytic hydrogen production system coupled with capturing carbon dioxide from flue gas. The system comprises an absorption device (1), an electrolytic hydrogen production device (2), a first gas-liquid separation device (3) and a second gas-liquid separation device (4). The electrolytic hydrogen production device (2) comprises an anode chamber (21), an intermediate chamber (22) and a cathode chamber (23), which are separated by anion exchange membranes (24). In addition, the present invention further relates to a method for using the electrolytic hydrogen production system coupled with capturing carbon dioxide from flue gas. The method comprises: absorbing carbon dioxide from flue gas by using the absorption device (1); allowing the obtained absorption liquid to enter the anode chamber (21), so as to obtain a carbon-dioxide-containing gas-liquid mixture; allowing the gas-liquid mixture to enter the first gas-liquid separation device (3) to undergo separation, so as to obtain carbon dioxide and a first separation liquid; allowing the first separation liquid to enter the intermediate chamber (22), so as to realize the regeneration of the absorbent under the action of ion exchange; and returning the regenerated absorbent to the absorption device (1) again to continue the absorption of carbon dioxide.

column12: Anode porous transmission layer for electrolyzed water as well as preparation method and application of anode porous transmission layer
column13: The invention relates to an anode porous transmission layer for water electrolysis and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a nickel substrate; cleaning the nickel substrate, drying and collecting; taking nickel salt, ferric salt, boric acid and ammonium chloride, and adding pure water to prepare electroplating liquid; hydrochloric acid is dropwise added into the electroplating solution, and the pH value is adjusted; a two-electrode electrolytic bath system is adopted, the dried nickel substrate is immersed in the electroplating liquid with the adjusted pH value for electroplating, and the modified anode porous transmission layer is obtained through aftertreatment. The broccoli-shaped structure containing nickel and iron elementary substances and alloy is formed on the surface of the modified substrate, so that the conductivity, the electrochemical stability and the interface transmission efficiency are remarkably improved, the catalyst loading is more uniform and firmer, reactant transmission and bubble escape are smooth, the contact resistance is reduced, and the service life is prolonged. The anode PTL material shows excellent electrocatalytic oxygen evolution performance in alkaline or anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, the hydrogen production energy consumption and cost are effectively reduced, and the technical problems of an existing anode PTL material and a modification method are solved.

column12: AEMWE cathode electrode material under large current density and macro preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides an AEMWE cathode electrode material and a preparation method thereof. The AEMWE cathode electrode material provided by the invention comprises a metal foam substrate, a transition metal hydroxide formed on the surface of the metal foam substrate, and a modified metal nanosheet array deposited on the surface of the metal hydroxide. Wherein the metal hydroxide in the middle layer can promote proton coupling electron transfer, induce metastable lattice distortion and promote formation of lattice dislocation/twin crystal/twisted crystal boundaries. Meanwhile, through the multi-field coupling effect of an electric field or an electric field and a magnetic field, controllable growth of nanosheets is achieved, the hydrogen evolution performance is effectively improved, the charge transfer resistance is greatly reduced, and the hydrogen evolution performance and long-period stability of the catalytic material under the conditions of large current density and industrialization are achieved. According to the AEMWE scheme provided by the invention, AEMWE water electrolysis hydrogen production under high current density can be realized only by 1.8 V, and stable operation exceeds 1000 hours.

column12: Method for producing hydrogen through electrolysis of water vapor
column13: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, and discloses a method for producing hydrogen through electrolysis of water vapor. The method comprises: under theaction of direct current, carrying out a reduction reaction on a cathode side to produce hydrogen, and carrying out an oxidation reaction on an anode side to produce oxygen, wherein the electrolyteson the anode side and the cathode side are water vapor with a temperature of 100-200 DEG C, the cathode side and the anode side are isolated by an electrode assembly, and the electrode assembly is anion exchange membrane with two side surfaces respectively coated with a cathode catalyst and an anode catalyst. According to the invention, by adopting the method, the low-heating-value waste heat steam with a temperature of 100-200 DEG C can be effectively utilized, the quick start-stop requirement can be met, the electrolysis device can be simplified, the electrolysis efficiency can be improved,and the energy consumption can be reduced.

column12: Cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production catalysis. The preparation method of the cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst comprises the following steps: mixing cobalt oxide and iron oxide, carrying out dispersion treatment by using isopropanol after first grinding, and then carrying out ball milling, cooling, washing and drying to obtain a precursor; and mixing the precursor and lithium chloride, performing secondary grinding, and sintering to obtain the ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst. The cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of high activity, high stability, long service life and low cost, can be used as an oxygen evolution catalyst of systems such as alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, has excellent catalytic performance, and can greatly reduce the energy consumption of water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: Hollow array oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of alkaline electrolyzed water. A self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode is obtained through a hydrothermal method in an alkaline medium; foamy copper is used as a substrate, the electrode structure comprises an outer layer consisting of a plurality of layered nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets and an inner layer consisting of cuprous sulfide hollow nanorods, and the final morphology characteristics are as follows: the average diameter of each nanorod is 100-500nm, and the length of each nanorod is 2-3mu m; the electrode can effectively control the morphology of a synthetic catalyst under mild conditions, and has good catalytic activity and stability. The electrode is applied to the oxygen evolution reaction in the water electrolysis hydrogen production process under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

column12: Amorphous Sr-CoOOHv ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of two-dimensional nano material electrocatalysts, and particularly relates to an amorphous Sr-CoOOHv ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The strontium-doped cobalt selenide nanobelt is prepared through a hydrothermal method to serve as a substrate, and in-situ electrochemical reconstruction is carried out under the alkaline electrolyzed water anode oxygen evolution reaction condition to obtain the strontium-doped cobalt selenide nanobelt. According to the Sr-CoOOHv ultrathin nanosheet rich in cobalt vacancies, due to the existence of the metal cobalt vacancies, cobalt-oxygen covalence can be enhanced, lattice oxygen can be activated, meanwhile, hydroxyl affinity can be improved, and the lattice oxygen can be filled, so that the catalyst shows excellent catalytic activity and durability in industrial application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: High-stability AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell capable of rapidly desorbing bubbles
column13: The high-stability AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell comprises a membrane electrode assembly, an electrode plate and an end plate, the membrane electrode assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, a catalytic layer plate, a gas diffusion layer plate and a bipolar plate, a bidirectional snakelike flow channel is formed in the side, close to the electrode plate, of the bipolar plate, and the end plate is arranged in the bipolar plate. A gas diffusion layer plate is arranged on the bipolar plate, a catalyst layer plate is arranged on the gas diffusion layer plate, a radial flow channel is arranged on one side of the bipolar plate close to the gas diffusion layer plate, a low-density through hole and a high-density through hole are arranged on the gas diffusion layer plate, and a groove is arranged on the catalyst layer plate. Through a bipolar plate gradient flow field and a turbulent flow increasing effect, electrolyte distribution dynamic balance is realized, gas discharge is accelerated, bubbles are forcibly stripped by utilizing a fluid momentum difference, rapid desorption of the bubbles is ensured, and through combination of high and low density through holes and micron-sized honeycomb grooves, the bubbles are directionally migrated and desorbed, and the desorption speed of the bubbles is accelerated.

column12: Three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional nanomaterial synthesis and electrolysis water catalysis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a chromium hydroxide nanocage as a precursor through a solvothermal method, protecting by utilizing silicon dioxide in a high-temperature nitridation process, and then etching to remove the silicon dioxide to prepare the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage. According to the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage provided by the invention, due to the confinement of the porous cavity and the unsaturated coordination edge, hydroxyl reactants can be enriched on a reaction interface, the formation and release of oxygen bubbles can be promoted, and the concentration of a dissolved oxygen product is reduced; the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage shows catalytic activity and long-term stability superior to those of a commercial ruthenium oxide catalyst in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production anode oxygen evolution reaction.

column12: AEM anode slurry and preparation method of membrane electrode of AEM anode slurry
column13: The invention discloses an AEM anode slurry and a preparation method of a membrane electrode thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing an anode catalyst with a first solvent, and fully ball-milling to obtain an anode catalyst prefabricated slurry; mixing the ionomer with a second solvent, adding a surfactant, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain an ionomer solution; mixing the anode catalyst prefabricated slurry with the ionomer solution, adding a proper amount of binder, and performing shear mixing to obtain anode catalyst slurry; the prepared AEM anode slurry and the corresponding cathode catalyst slurry are respectively coated or coated and transferred on two sides of an anion exchange membrane to obtain a membrane electrode. column12: Preparation method of heterogeneous nano-particle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material and product and application of heterogeneous nano-particle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heterogeneous nanoparticle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material as well as a product and application of the heterogeneous nanoparticle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material, and belongs to the field of green hydrogen production energy. According to the method, CuBTC is used as a precursor, RuCl3 and phosphorous acid inorganic salt are sequentially introduced and quantitatively loaded on carbon paper, and then rapid carbonization treatment is performed through a direct laser scribing technology. The octahedral structure of the precursor is converted into the network-shaped graphene composite structure by regulating and controlling the doping amount of Ru and P, the laser power, the scribing distance and other parameters, and more active sites are exposed. The obtained material has excellent hydrogen evolution catalytic activity and stability under the alkaline condition, is simple in preparation method and low in cost, can replace a commercial Pt/C catalyst, and is suitable for the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: POLYARYL ISATIN-BASED CATIONIC POLYMER, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
column13: Provided in the present invention are a polyaryl isatin-based cationic polymer, a preparation method therefor, and the use thereof. The cationic polymer is a novel polyaryl isatin scaffold synthesized by a Friedel-Crafts polycondensation reaction under the catalysis of a superacid. An isatin structural unit in the cationic polymer possesses a very large molecular volume, which can improve the dimensional stability and mechanical properties of the cationic polymer after film formation; in addition, the N site of a cation grafted onto the cationic polymer is located on the para-position of the isatin structural unit, and such a remote grafting strategy can further improve the alkali resistance stability of the cation in the film. Therefore, the cationic polymer of the present invention exhibits extremely high ionic conductivity and mechanical and chemical stability, and can thus be used as an anion exchange membrane or an anion exchange polymer adhesive for alkaline water electrolysis, alkaline fuel cells, carbon dioxide reduction and flow batteries.

column12: Preparation method of CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst growing on foamed nickel and application of CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst in anion exchange membrane water electrolysis
column13: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of nano materials, and discloses a CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst growing on foamed nickel and a preparation method and application of the CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst. Alkali cobalt carbonate (CoCH) is used as a precursor, a crystalline phase CoP substrate is generated through a low-temperature phosphating method, then the surface of the crystalline phase CoP substrate is uniformly coated with an amorphous Co (OH) 2 layer through an electro-deposition process, and the self-supporting phosphating/hydroxyl heterogeneous structure catalyst (CoP/Co (OH) 2) is successfully constructed. The obtained CoP/Co (OH) 2 shows excellent complete water splitting performance, and is benefited from the high-activity specific surface area (Cdl = 44.66 mF cm <-2 >) and the interface rapid electron conduction characteristic (Rct = 0.43 omega) of a heterogeneous structure; when two electrodes are assembled to fully decompose water, the cell voltage is only 1.780 V when the current density is 250 mA cm <-2 >, and after continuous operation is carried out for 24 hours, the performance is basically kept unchanged, and the voltage fluctuation ratio is lower than 0.5%. CoP/Co (OH) 2 is prepared into a 2 * 2cm < 2 > self-supporting electrode to construct AEMWE, only 2.08 V cell voltage is needed under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 >, the AEMWE can stably run for 250 hours, the attenuation rate is 80 mu V h <-1 >, meanwhile, the hydrogen production efficiency is calculated to reach 96.2% through gas metering and Faraday law, and the engineering potential of the AEMWE in large-scale hydrogen production application is verified.

column12: Method for preparing electrolyzed water catalyst through ultrafast corrosion and application
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolysis water catalysis, and discloses a method for preparing an electrolysis water catalyst based on ultrafast electrochemical corrosion. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing deep eutectic ionic liquid (DEIL) from choline chloride and ethylene glycol, adding metal salt and thiourea to form electrolyte, and carrying out electro-deposition within 15 seconds through a two-electrode system to obtain the sulfide catalyst. The method has the advantages of high preparation speed (shortened by more than 100 times compared with a traditional method), excellent catalytic activity (241 mV at 100 mA cm <-2 >), high stability (the performance is attenuated by 57 mV after continuous working for 100 hours) and the like, and is particularly suitable for large-scale preparation of the anode catalyst layer of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

column12: Water electrolysis hydrogen production device with turbulent flow strengthening module and method
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a water electrolysis hydrogen production device with a turbulent flow strengthening module and a method, an end pressing polar plate comprises a cathode end pressing polar plate and an anode end pressing polar plate, and a square groove for placing a flow field module is formed in the center of the inner side of the end pressing polar plate; the flow field module comprises a cathode flow field module and an anode flow field module, one surface is smooth, and the other surface is provided with a snakelike thread flow channel; the metal electrode comprises a metal cathode and a metal anode and is a porous electrode; and the diaphragm is positioned between the cathode end pressing plate and the anode end pressing plate. column12: Carbon-supported ruthenium alloy hydrogen evolution catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a carbon-supported ruthenium alloy hydrogen evolution catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. A carbon material with a hydrophilic surface is used as a carrier, metal ions are uniformly adsorbed on the surface of the carbon material by utilizing coulomb force between active groups on the surface of the carbon material and the metal ions, then uniformly-loaded ruthenium alloy nanoparticles are prepared by a one-step wet chemical method or a two-step precipitation-reduction method, the particle size of the obtained alloy is smaller than 3nm, and the ruthenium content is lower than 10wt%. The problems that a catalyst prepared in the prior art is high in cost, complex in process, low in hydrogen production efficiency and the like are solved.

column12: Hierarchical heterostructure electrocatalyst for ethanol electrocatalytic oxidation and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalytic materials and energy conversion, and particularly relates to a hierarchical heterostructure electro-catalyst for ethanol electro-catalytic oxidation as well as a preparation method and application of the hierarchical heterostructure electro-catalyst. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a conductive substrate; growing an amorphous porous transition metal sulfide layer on the surface of the conductive substrate in situ to obtain a composite intermediate; the transition metal sulfide is nickel sulfide; and performing in-situ growth of a two-dimensional metal organic framework nanosheet array on the surface of the composite intermediate to obtain a target product. Good application prospects are shown in ethanol-assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production and anion exchange membrane electrolysis cells.

column12: Method for producing a catalyst for water electrolysis containing copper cobalt sulfide and tungsten disulfide
column13: The method for manufacturing a catalyst for water electrolysis according to the present invention comprises: a first step of hydrothermally synthesizing copper-cobalt bilayer hydroxide (cuco ldh) on a metal foam by using a solution including a copper precursor and a cobalt precursor; and a second step of forming a hybrid structure by hydrothermally synthesizing the copper-cobalt bilayer hydroxide in a solution including a tungsten precursor and a sulfur precursor. column12: High-activity alkaline hydrogen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof

column12: Carbonate intercalated iron-cobalt-nickel layered hydroxide catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a carbonate intercalated iron-cobalt-nickel layered hydroxide catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. The carbonate intercalated iron-cobalt-nickel layered hydroxide catalyst comprises iron-cobalt-nickel hydroxide laminates and carbonate ions located between the laminates, and in the iron-cobalt-nickel hydroxide, the molar ratio of an iron element to a cobalt element to a nickel element is 1: (0.025-3): (0.25-4) in sequence. column12: Phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode for high-current hydrogen production as well as preparation method and application of phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode
column13: The invention provides a phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode for high-current hydrogen production as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing foamed nickel subjected to acid pickling treatment with a red phosphorus solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction to obtain NiP; the preparation method comprises the following steps: immersing NiP into a mixed solution of cobalt acetate tetrahydrate and 2-methylimidazole to obtain Co-ZIF-L-coated NiP; and the Co-ZIF-L (at) NiP is immersed in a ferrous sulfate tetrahydrate solution, and the CoFe-LDH (at) NiP-120 electrode is obtained through heating. An anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device (AEM) based on the electrode shows remarkable activity when the voltage is 1.85 V, the current density reaches 100 mA cm <-2 >, and obvious performance degradation does not occur when the AEM stably operates for 70 h under the large current density of 100 mA cm <-2 >. Compared with an existing electrolyzed water electrode, the method has the characteristics that active sites are accurately regulated and controlled, the structural stability is improved, and the process cost is reduced.

column12: Platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound as well as rapid high-throughput preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound as well as a rapid high-flux preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, fully ultrasonically mixing a metal salt precursor, an inorganic auxiliary reagent and carbon black, freeze-drying the mixed solution, and then carrying out short-time Joule heating treatment to prepare the carbon-loaded platinum-rare earth-based intermetallic compound catalyst. Compared with reported preparation methods such as a physical metallurgy method and an electric arc melting method, the method has the advantages that the platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound catalyst can be rapidly prepared at high flux, the prepared intermetallic compound is uniformly distributed on the surface of carbon black and is uniform in size and small in particle size, the problem of agglomeration of nano-particles is avoided, and meanwhile the platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound catalyst has the advantages of being stable in structure, high in stability and the like. And the composite material has multiple active sites, shows excellent electrocatalytic activity on cathode hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system, and has considerable energy application potential.

column12: Thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode as well as preparation method and application of thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure (Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF) composite electrode. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cutting and cleaning the foamed nickel substrate; the preparation method comprises the following steps: growing a nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet on a foamed nickel substrate through a constant-voltage deposition method; nickel-cobalt-iron prussian blue analogue nanoparticles grow in situ on the surface of the nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet through an ion exchange method; and preparing the Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF composite electrode through a thermal shock method. The composite electrode has excellent catalytic activity and stability as a working electrode for hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution reactions. The composite electrode can be directly used as a cathode and an anode of an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell to efficiently catalyze a full-water decomposition reaction at different temperatures, and the electrolytic cell can stably operate for 1000 hours and 240 hours under the current densities of 0.1 A cm <-2 > and 1.0 A cm <-2 > respectively, so that the composite electrode has a good application prospect.

column12: Modeling method, system, medium and equipment for unified operation model of mixed electrolytic cell
column13: The invention provides a unified operation modeling method, system, medium and equipment for a mixed electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of electrolytic bath hydrogen production, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining fixed data, operation data and technical data of different types of electrolytic baths; based on the obtained fixed data and the operation data, different types of electrolytic cell electrochemical models are established, and hydrogen production efficiency curves of different types of electrolytic cells are drawn according to the established electrolytic cell electrochemical models and by utilizing a Faraday calculation formula; and on the basis of hydrogen production efficiency curves and technical data of the two types of electrolytic cells, depicting constraint conditions, and establishing a mixed electrolytic cell unified operation model. For an alkaline electrolytic cell (AEL) and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell (AEMEL), the difference of the technical characteristics of hydrogen production efficiency, starting time delay, upper and lower limits of input electric power and the like of the two types of electrolytic cells is fully considered, and a unified operation model covering the input-output response relation constraint, the operation interval and the climbing constraint of the electrolytic cells is constructed.

column12: Chloride ion intercalation nickel-iron layered double hydroxide catalytic electrode as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a chloride ion intercalation ferronickel layered double hydroxide as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electro-catalytic materials. The chloride ions occupy the interlayer domain and do not damage the main body laminate structure, and the interlayer spacing is stably expanded through the electrostatic interaction. The method for preparing the material by a one-step hydrothermal method comprises the following steps: immersing the foamed nickel into a mixed solution containing chlorine salt, nickel salt, ferric salt and urea for hydrothermal reaction to obtain the in-situ growth nano flower-shaped array structure catalytic electrode. The overpotential of the catalytic electrode in alkaline water oxidation under 10mAcm <-2 > is only 179mV, and the catalytic electrode can stably operate for more than 500 hours in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device, and has excellent electrooxidation activity on biomass molecules such as glycerol, methanol, ethanol, urea and the like. The method is simple in preparation process, low in cost and suitable for the fields of alkaline water electrolysis and biomass-assisted electrolytic hydrogen production.

column12: Acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode and application thereof. The acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode is formed by hot-pressing and compounding a hydrogen evolution gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane loaded with a hydrogen evolution catalyst, a proton exchange membrane loaded with an oxygen evolution catalyst and an oxygen evolution gas diffusion layer, wherein the catalyst is sprayed on the surface of the membrane through an electrostatic spraying method, so that the prepared catalyst layer is uniform in structure, fluffy and porous, has abundant catalytic active sites, and can provide sufficient channels for mass transfer and diffusion of electrolyte and gas. According to the acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode, acid-base neutralization energy can be effectively utilized, so that the theoretical voltage of hydrogen production by electrolysis of water is effectively reduced; the acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode water electrolysis device is constructed on the basis of the acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode, and the device not only can realize higher catalytic current density under lower voltage, but also has excellent electro-catalysis stability, and can improve the compactness and hydrogen purity of an electrolysis structure, so that the device has a good application prospect.

column13: The gas-liquid separation and liquid storage balancing device comprises a cathode liquid storage chamber and an anode liquid storage chamber, one side wall of the cathode liquid storage chamber is fixedly provided with a cathode flow channel communicated with the inside of the cathode liquid storage chamber, one side wall of the anode liquid storage chamber is fixedly provided with an anode flow channel communicated with the inside of the anode liquid storage chamber, and the cathode flow channel is communicated with the inside of the anode liquid storage chamber. column12: Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as a preparation method and an application of the Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst. The catalyst is prepared by taking nickel and cerium ions as precursors through a one-step controllable incomplete reduction method, the process is simple, the yield is close to 100%, and the catalyst is suitable for mass production. In the catalyst, CeO2 effectively promotes water molecule dissociation, NiO species finely regulates and controls a hydrogen intermediate (H *) adjacent to a nickel active site to adsorb free energy, the bottleneck problems that a traditional nickel-based material is too high in H * adsorption and slow in water dissociation kinetics are synergistically solved, the catalyst shows excellent hydrogen evolution reaction activity in a 1M KOH electrolyte, and the catalyst can be applied to the field of hydrogen production. The overpotential is only 62 mV (relative to a reversible hydrogen electrode) under the current density of 10 mA cm <-2 >, and the performance is equivalent to that of a commercial 60% Pt/C catalyst; after the electrode is pressed into an integral electrode, the electrode can stably run for 300 hours under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 > without activity attenuation. The catalyst disclosed by the invention is suitable for cathode hydrogen evolution reaction of alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water systems, and has an important industrial application prospect.

column12: Nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis and gassing, in particular to a nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode comprises a nickel-selenium-based electrocatalyst and a conductive current collector, the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is of a three-dimensional structure integrating a self-supporting micro-nano array mesh structure and a mesh conductive current collector, wherein the self-supporting micro-nano array mesh structure is assembled by secondary crosslinking of nanosheets, and the preparation method of the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode comprises the step of in-situ growth of a nickel-selenium-based electrocatalyst on the mesh conductive current collector. column12: Nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof. A cleaned substrate nickel felt is soaked in a metal salt solution, taken out, subjected to vacuum drying and then reduced in a hydrogen atmosphere, and the self-supporting electrode can be prepared. The formed catalyst particles are in a nickel-iron-cobalt alloy state and grow in dense pores of the nickel fibers, and the unique self-supporting structure is beneficial to proceeding of the mass transfer process, reduction of charge transfer resistance and improvement of electrode stability. When the electrode is used for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the current density is as high as 2.3 A cm <-2 > under the cell pressure of 2.0 V. During a durability test, the electrode maintains stability for more than 1400 hours at a current density of 1 A cm <-2 >. The preparation process does not need to use a binder, the production cost is reduced, and the catalyst is expected to be applied to the actual water electrolysis hydrogen production process due to excellent catalytic performance and durability.

column12: Preparation method of perovskite-based catalyst membrane electrode assembly for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalysis, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a perovskite-based catalyst membrane electrode assembly for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. The perovskite material is prepared by using a sol-gel method, the A site has a vacancy defect, and the B site is doped with reducible transitional metal. A perovskite material is prepared into catalyst printing ink, the catalyst printing ink is sprayed on the surface of foamed nickel, in-situ reduction is carried out in a tubular furnace, reducible metal is separated out from perovskite oxide crystal lattices, nano-particles are formed on the surface of the catalyst, a unique combination mode with a catalyst body exists, and good thermodynamic and chemical stability is shown. The metal nanoparticles are embedded into the metal structure of the perovskite material, so that the metal nanoparticles separated out from crystal lattices of the perovskite oxide show excellent stability and excellent catalytic performance. The invention provides a novel catalyst and a membrane electrode preparation method for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank, so that the water electrolysis hydrogen production efficiency is effectively improved, and the cost is reduced.

column12: Hydrogen production method for coupling preparation of azofurazan energetic material based on WS2/Pt composite catalyst
column13: The invention discloses a hydrogen production method for preparing an azofurazan energetic material by coupling based on a WS2/Pt composite catalyst, which comprises the following steps: placing a CC (at) Pt/WS2 electrode in a sodium carbonate solution, and placing a copper oxide nanowire electrode in an amino furazan-containing alkali solution; a CC (at) Pt/WS2 electrode is taken as a cathode, and a copper oxide nanowire electrode is taken as an anode, so that an H-type electrolysis system separated by an anion exchange membrane is formed; based on the H-type electrolysis system, cathode hydrogen production and anode 3, 3 '-diamino-4, 4'-azofurazan energetic material synthesis are achieved. According to the method, a reaction for synthesizing the 3, 3 '-diamino-4, 4'-azofurazan energetic material through electrochemical oxidation with a lower oxidation potential is used for replacing a traditional oxygen evolution reaction, and is coupled with water electrolysis hydrogen production, so that low-energy-consumption hydrogen production and green synthesis of the azofurazan energetic material can be realized.

column12: Preparation method and application of non-noble metal Ni-based oxygen evolution catalyst
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a non-noble metal Ni-based oxygen evolution catalyst. The catalyst provided by the invention comprises nickel selenide nanoparticles and graphene quantum dots loaded on the surfaces of the nickel selenide nanoparticles, wherein the mass ratio of the graphene quantum dots to the nickel selenide nanoparticles is (1-8): 50. The graphene quantum dots can be loaded on the surface of nickel selenide through a simple hydrothermal reaction, the preparation method is simple and convenient, the overpotential of an oxygen evolution reaction can be greatly reduced while the cost of the prepared catalyst is reduced, and the catalyst has relatively high electrochemical performance and stability in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and is suitable for industrial production. Wide application prospects are realized.

column12: AEM electrolytic cell assembly process and membrane electrode preparation method
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen energy equipment manufacturing, and discloses an AEM electrolytic cell assembly process and a membrane electrode preparation method, the preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, slurry preparation: respectively preparing anode slurry and cathode slurry; s2, diffusion layer treatment: soaking and cleaning the diffusion layer; and S3, slurry transfer: respectively and uniformly spraying cathode slurry and anode slurry on the diffusion layer treated in the S2 by using a spraying machine to obtain a catalyst layer/diffusion layer complex. S4, membrane pretreatment: carrying out soaking and cleaning treatment on the anion exchange membrane; s5, AEM groove assembly is carried out; and S6, testing the membrane electrode prepared in the step S5. In the membrane electrode preparation process, the catalyst utilization rate is increased by 40%, and the precious metal consumption is reduced by 30%. The qualified rate of the membrane electrode is increased from 75% to 95%, in addition, the overall performance of the membrane electrode reaches the current density (60 DEG C/1M KOH) of 1 A/cm under the voltage of 1.622 V, and the attenuation rate of 200 h is stabilized; 3%.

column12: Testing method for real-time measurement of internal temperature field distribution of bipolar plate of AEM electrolytic cell
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of sensor monitoring, in particular to a testing method for real-time measurement of internal temperature field distribution of a bipolar plate of an AEM electrolytic bath, which comprises the following steps of: arranging a micro blind hole array aligned with a runner ridge part on the side, opposite to a membrane electrode, of the bipolar plate, and packaging an all-medium fluorescent temperature measurement probe at the bottom of the hole in situ; and a high-thermal-conductivity insulating medium is used for eliminating contact thermal resistance. Signals are led out to an external multi-dimensional signal demodulation unit through the multi-core optical fiber bundle and the pressure self-tightening sealing assembly. The central signal processing engine adopts a time-gated photon counting logic and differential noise suppression technology, captures a fluorescence decay characteristic time constant, inverts a distributed temperature field of an internal reaction zone of the bipolar plate, and realizes dynamic early warning of the health state of the anion exchange membrane in combination with a thermal degradation model. According to the invention, the problem that the temperature field in the electrolytic cell is difficult to accurately and nondestructively monitor in real time in high-voltage, strong-alkali and electromagnetic interference environments is solved, and data support is provided for thermal management and safe operation of the AEM electrolytic cell.

column12: Polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, preparation method and application
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-molecular polymer membrane materials, and discloses a polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The raw materials comprise an aryl monomer and 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde, or the aryl monomer, the 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde and a branching agent. A benzyl-containing piperidinium molecular framework is designed, a piperidine ring is connected with a main chain through a flexible spacer, meanwhile, benzyl is connected to an N atom, and the benzyl has large steric hindrance, so that the stability of AEM under an alkaline condition, especially under a high-temperature and high-concentration severe condition, is effectively relieved. Branching agents such as triphenylbenzene are added into a main chain structure to enhance the mechanical property and alkali-resistant stability of the main chain structure, and the polymer electrolyte membrane with high conductivity, high mechanical property and high alkali resistance is prepared by adopting a simple solution casting method and is applied to AEMWE.

column12: NiFe-based LDH catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of electro-catalysis, in particular to a NiFe-based LDH catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the NiFe-based LDH catalyst is innovatively prepared by using a simple one-step hydrothermal method under the condition that a pH regulator does not need to be additionally added, and charge sharing among NiFe LDH metals is induced by introducing metal M into NiFe LDH, so that the catalytic activity of the NiFe-based LDH catalyst is improved, and the catalytic activity of the NiFe-based LDH catalyst is improved. column12: Electrolyzed water catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of alkaline electrolyzed water, in particular to an electrolyzed water catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The electrolyzed water catalyst provided by the invention realizes successful doping of alkali metal, replaces atoms on the surface of a non-platinum metal cluster without changing the size of the cluster, realizes improvement of alkaline hydrogen evolution performance, and specifically, the alkali metal is doped with the non-Pt metal cluster, and the surface microenvironment of the catalyst is regulated and controlled, so that the hydrogen evolution performance is improved. Stronger interaction between alkali metal ions and interface water is utilized to promote water dissociation, so that improvement of alkaline hydrogen evolution kinetics is promoted, and long-term stable operation under high current is realized. According to the preparation method, the non-platinum metal cluster is successfully loaded on the nitrogen-doped carbon material by adopting a post-adsorption and one-step pyrolysis method, the metal loading capacity is reduced, the preparation method of the economical and effective AEMWE catalyst is provided, and the large-current and stable water electrolysis performance under low cell pressure is shown in an alkaline AEM electrolytic tank.

column12: High-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, preparation method and application
column13: The invention discloses a high-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, a preparation method and application, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, uniformly mixing a certain amount of nickel salt solution and a certain amount of iron salt solution respectively, and then putting an activated nickel-containing substrate material into the mixed solution; and 2, depositing at room temperature for a certain time to obtain the catalytic electrode with a ferro-nickel double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst growing on the surface. The invention designs a synthesis method for normal-temperature in-situ growth of a nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) oxygen evolution catalyst on a nickel-containing substrate material, low-cost batch green synthesis with nearly 100% of raw material utilization rate, zero waste liquid and no size limitation is realized, and the obtained catalytic electrode has excellent oxygen evolution catalytic performance and long-time stability; the method can be directly applied to alkaline (ALK) electrolytic baths and anion exchange membrane (AEM) electrolytic baths, the cost of the ALK electrolytic baths and the AEM electrolytic baths is remarkably reduced, and the method has important industrial application value.

column12: Hydrogen-oxygen generating assembly and hydrogen-oxygen generating equipment
column13: The utility model discloses a hydrogen-oxygen generating assembly and hydrogen-oxygen generating equipment. The hydrogen and oxygen generating assembly comprises a mounting substrate and two electrolysis modules, and the mounting substrate is arranged between the two electrolysis modules; wherein a water inlet flow channel and a water outlet flow channel are formed in the mounting base plate, andthe water inlet flow channel and the water outlet flow channel respectively penetrate through the mounting base plate; wherein the electrolysis module comprises a positive plate, a negative plate, anion exchange membrane and a titanium mesh, the ion exchange membrane is arranged between the positive plate and the negative plate, a first water permeable hole and a second water permeable hole are formed in the positive plate, the titanium mesh is arranged between the positive plate and the ion exchange membrane, and the titanium mesh is arranged between the negative plate and the ion exchange membrane. The preparation method of the ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor solution containing ferrous ions and ferric ions; the foamed nickel substrate is cleaned; the cleaned foamed nickel is tightly attached to the surface of the bottom of the reaction container, the foamed nickel is immersed in the precursor solution, under the room-temperature standing condition, divalent and trivalent iron ions are induced to be subjected to a synergistic hydrolysis and coprecipitation reaction through a physical interface confinement space formed by an attached interface, and the nickel-based composite material is obtained. Therefore, a high-activity and high-uniformity nickel-iron-based (oxygen) hydroxide catalyst layer (DIC-NiFeOOH/NF) is grown on the surface of the foamed nickel in situ. The method is simple in process, green and energy-saving, and the prepared nickel-iron-based oxygen evolution electrode shows excellent performance in oxygen evolution reaction and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis.

column12: Preparation method of self-supporting anode catalyst, catalyst and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a self-supporting anode catalyst, the catalyst and application of the catalyst, and relates to the technical field of electrolyzed water oxygen evolution catalysts.The method comprises the steps that a foamed ferronickel substrate is provided and pretreated; immersing the pretreated foamed ferronickel substrate into the first precursor solution for standing reaction, forming a transition metal sulfide layer on the surface of the substrate through in-situ growth, and washing and drying to obtain an intermediate product; and placing the intermediate product in a second precursor solution for hydrothermal reaction, and growing on the surface of the transition metal sulfide layer to form a layered double hydroxide catalyst layer, thereby obtaining the self-supporting anode catalyst with a three-layer structure of layered double hydroxide, transition metal oxide and foamed ferronickel. According to the invention, the problems of weak binding force between a non-noble metal anode catalyst layer and a substrate and poor stability under high current density can be effectively solved, so that high-activity, high-stability and long-life oxygen evolution reaction in an alkaline or anion exchange membrane electrolysis water system can be realized.

column12: Selenium vacancy-containing high-entropy selenide catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a selenium vacancy-containing high-entropy selenide catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst is prepared from a nickel-based base material and a high-entropy selenide on the surface of the nickel-based base material, wherein the high-entropy selenide is (FeCoNiVCrMn) Se < 2 >. According to the method, Fe, Co, Ni, V, Cr and Mn metal salts are prepared into a mixed precursor solution, a multi-metal precursor layer is formed on the surface of a nickel-based substrate through electro-deposition, and then Joule heating rapid annealing is adopted in the presence of an inert atmosphere and a selenium source, so that high-entropy selenylation and Se vacancy construction are realized. In the catalyst, Se vacancy can promote water molecule activation and improve hydrogen evolution performance; in the oxygen evolution process, the surface of the catalyst is subjected to in-situ reconstruction to form a high-entropy hydroxide active phase, and a SeO4 < 2-> interface layer is synchronously generated/anchored and used for regulating reaction intermediate adsorption and inhibiting metal dissolution and Cl <-> corrosion. The catalyst is suitable for alkaline seawater electrolysis and anion exchange membrane full-water decomposition devices, and has high activity, high stability and excellent corrosion resistance.

column12: Composite bifunctional catalyst based on perovskite as well as preparation method and application of composite bifunctional catalyst
column13: The invention provides a perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst with rich active sites. The perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst is composed of a main phase perovskite oxide substrate with electrochemical activity and a nanosheet proton conductor beta-NaFeO2 with excellent proton affinity. A two-step self-assembly strategy is adopted for preparation of the composite catalyst, and formation of a high-energy interface between two phases is ensured, so that an electronic structure between a perovskite substrate and a proton conductor is effectively adjusted, and multiple active sites beneficial to oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution reaction are induced. On one hand, the formed two-phase high-energy interface is helpful for exciting lattice oxygen on the surface of the catalyst to participate in oxygen evolution reaction, so that the lattice oxygen is induced to participate in an oxygen evolution reaction mechanism; the deprotonation rate of an oxygen evolution reaction and the water splitting rate of a hydrogen evolution reaction are accelerated through the cooperation of the composite material and a proton conductor, so that the oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution performance of the composite material is greatly improved, and the composite material has a good application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: Porous transmission layer and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membrane electrolysis, in particular to a porous transmission layer and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps that a porous transmission layer base material is selected, the porous transmission layer base material comprises an inner-layer nickel net and an outer-layer nickel net, and the inner-layer nickel net and the outer-layer nickel net are subjected to ultrasonic cleaning; performing etching treatment on the outer-layer nickel net subjected to ultrasonic cleaning to obtain a porous transmission layer base material subjected to etching treatment; carrying out multi-stage cleaning treatment on the etched porous transmission layer base material; and carrying out drying treatment on the porous transmission layer base material subjected to the multi-stage cleaning treatment to obtain the porous transmission layer. According to the preparation method, the inner layer and the outer layer of the porous transmission layer base material are subjected to differentiated treatment, so that the inner layer keeps the original structure to ensure the interface stability, the surface appearance of the outer layer is optimized through accurate acid etching, and the interface contact performance and the mass transfer efficiency of the porous transmission layer prepared through the preparation method are greatly improved.

column12: Dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of macromolecules, and particularly discloses a dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer, which successfully overcomes the defect that a main chain of a traditional polyarylether material is easy to break and degrade under a strong alkali condition by introducing a dibenzofuran structure, improves the chemical stability and the thermal stability of the material, and has a good application prospect. A benzene ring, quaternary ammonium or piperidine cation group is introduced by utilizing a side chain suspension strategy, microphase separation in the polymer is effectively promoted, and an efficient ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the membrane material has good hydroxyl ion conductivity which can be up to 170.2 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C while a relatively low swelling rate is maintained, and the membrane material can be widely applied to the field of membrane materials. The polymer shows excellent mechanical properties, the tensile strength of a dry film is excellent, the alkali-resistant durability is excellent, and the conductivity loss is small when the polymer is soaked in a strong alkali (KOH) solution at 80 DEG C for more than 1800 hours. The anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has good application value in the fields of fuel cells, water electrolysis hydrogen production and the like, and shows strong commercial potential.

column12: PtRu-based nanocage catalyst based on chromium regulation and control as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a PtRu-based nanocage catalyst based on chromium regulation and a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) introducing a ruthenium precursor, a platinum precursor and a chromium precursor into a ZIF-8 metal organic framework material, and carrying out reaction adsorption loading to form a multi-metal precursor/ZIF-8 compound with a hollow porous nanocage structure; (2) carrying out heat treatment on the multi-metal precursor/ZIF-8 compound in a hydrogen-containing reducing atmosphere to obtain a PtRuCrZnO intermediate; and (3) removing ZnO in the PtRuCrZnO intermediate by adopting an acidic etching solution, so as to obtain the PtRu-based nanocage catalyst. The obtained catalyst is particularly suitable for an AEMWE system, and a technical scheme capable of being implemented on a large scale is provided for constructing a low-precious-metal-loaded and high-efficiency water electrolysis hydrogen production catalytic material.

column12: Low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, and discloses a low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst comprises an M-N-C substrate formed by anchoring metal M on nitrogen-doped carbon at a single point location, and Ru uniformly distributed on the M-N-C substrate, wherein the metal M comprises at least one of Ga, In, Sn or Sb. According to the low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst, metal M is anchored on nitrogen-doped carbon (N-C) in a unit point form to form M-N-C, Ru is uniformly distributed on an M-N-C carrier in the form of clusters of about 2 nm, and strong catalyst-carrier interaction is generated between the Ru clusters and the M-N-C due to interaction between Ru and M. Meanwhile, Ru-H adsorption can be optimized, and the oxophilic M further enhances the water dissociation capacity, so that the alkaline HER performance is improved. The Ru content of the electrocatalyst is low, the Ru loading capacity at the cathode of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is only about 0.08 mg cm <-2 >, and the cost is greatly reduced while the catalytic activity is guaranteed.

column12: PtRu nanocage as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a PtRu nanocage and a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) adsorbing ruthenium chloride and chloroplatinic acid to ZIF-8 to form a PtRu ZIF-8 composite material; (2) performing high-temperature calcination on the PtRu-ZIF-8 composite material in a hydrogen-argon reducing atmosphere to reduce the PtRu-ZIF-8 composite material into metal Ru and Pt, and forming an intermetallic compound by Zn generated by decomposition of ZIF-8, Ru and Pt to obtain a PtRuZn composite material; and (3) selectively etching the PtRuZn composite material by using a hydrochloric acid solution to remove Zn so as to obtain the PtRu nanocage with the cage-shaped structure. The method is easy and convenient to operate, the catalytic activity can be remarkably improved, and the Pt dosage can be greatly reduced. The material is suitable for AEMWE, and a new solution is provided for developing a low-cost and high-stability water electrolysis hydrogen production technology.

column12: NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: removing oil stain and an oxide layer on the surface of foamed nickel; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving nickel nitrate and ammonium molybdate in deionized water, putting the solution and foamed nickel into a high-pressure reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction, and growing NiMoO4 on a foamed nickel substrate in situ; after the reaction is finished, cleaning and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with NiMoO4; soaking the Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam in a ferric salt solution to obtain Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam; and soaking the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x catalyst in alkali liquor, cleaning and drying to obtain the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst. The preparation method is simple and safe, large-scale production can be achieved, and the prepared catalyst has a three-dimensional hierarchical structure and shows excellent catalytic performance and stability in a three-electrode system and an AEMWE electrolytic cell.
